title: Commercial Account Executive, UK
description:
Get to Know Us

Horizon3.ai is a fast-growing, remote cybersecurity company dedicated to the mission of enabling organisations to proactively find and fix and verify exploitable attack vectors before criminals exploit them. Our flagship product, the NodeZeroTM platform, delivers production-safe autonomous pentests and other key assessment operations that scale across the largest internal, external, cloud, and hybrid cloud environments. NodeZero has been adopted by organisations of all sizes, from small educational institutions to government agencies and Global 100 enterprises. It is used by ITOps/SecOps teams, consulting pentesters, and MSSPs and MSPs.

We are a fusion of former U.S. Special Operations cyber operators, startup engineers, and formerly frustrated cybersecurity practitioners. We're committed to helping solve our common security problems: ineffective security tools, false positives resulting in alert fatigue, blind spots, "checkbox” security culture, cybersecurity skills shortage, and the long lead time and expense of hiring outside consultants. Collectively, we are a team of learn it alls, committed to a culture of respect, collaboration, ownership, and results.

Role Description

Help shape the next stage of Horizon3.ai’s UK growth. Based in the Netherlands with regular UK travel, you’ll bring autonomous pentesting to new customers and help them reduce real-world security risk. If you thrive on opening doors, building partnerships and turning opportunities into wins, this is a chance to make a visible impact as we expand our UK Commercial team.

We currently require our Amsterdam team to come to the office 2 - 3 days per week.

What You’ll Do

Grow Horizon3.ai’s UK Commercial business by winning new customers, developing productive channel partnerships and helping organisations realise value from our cybersecurity solutions.

  • Win new accounts and expand our customer base by introducing disruptive cybersecurity software solutions to the UK market.

  • Build and convert a qualified pipeline, owning the sales cycle from qualification and proof of value through negotiation and close, with the goal of exceeding quota consistently quarter over quarter.

  • Turn channel partnerships into revenue by proactively engaging regional resellers and developing joint opportunities.

  • Demonstrate Horizon3.ai solutions in virtual and in-person meetings, connecting technical capabilities to customer needs and business outcomes.

  • Drive the post-proof of value ROI process, helping customers understand business value while building relationships that support satisfaction and retention.

  • Maintain accurate customer records, pipeline data and forecasts in Salesforce so opportunities, risks and next steps are clearly understood.

  • Work independently to progress opportunities while collaborating with distributed sales, support and customer success teams to deliver a coordinated customer experience.

What You’ll Bring

  • At least 5 years of successful cybersecurity sales experience, with a track record of driving growth, introducing disruptive software solutions and consistently exceeding quarterly quotas.

  • Previous experience selling technical solutions into the UK market.

  • Experience establishing and monetising channel partnerships; existing relationships with key regional resellers are essential.

  • Proficiency across the full sales process, including qualification, proof of value, forecasting, negotiation, deal closure and post-proof of value ROI management.

  • The ability to present and demonstrate cybersecurity solutions effectively, both virtually and in person.

  • Strong CRM discipline and experience maintaining accurate pipeline records and forecasts in Salesforce (SFDC).

  • Familiarity with Challenger Question-Based Selling-type methodologies and sales tools such as Outreach, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, ZoomInfo and Slack.

  • The ability to work independently and collaborate effectively with distributed teams.

  • Fluency in English; additional language skills are welcomed.

Travel Required

We are a hybrid company, and this job will require you to spend 3 days based at our Amsterdam city centre sales hub. The role may require up to 40% of travel within the assigned territory to be successful. Job-related travel expenses are reviewed and must be approved by your manager.

Perks of Horizon3.ai

  • Inclusive Team: We value diversity and promote an inclusive culture where everyone can thrive.

  • Growth Opportunities: Be part of a dynamic and growing team with numerous career development opportunities.

  • Innovative Culture: Work in a collaborative environment that encourages creativity and out-of-the-box thinking.

  • Remote Work: We are a 100% remote company. Enjoy the flexibility to work in the way that supports you and brings out your best.

  • Competitive Compensation: We offer competitive salary, equity and benefits. Our benefits include health, vision & dental insurance for you and your family, a flexible vacation policy, and generous parental leave.

You Belong Here

Horizon3.ai is not just an equal opportunity employer - we are a community that values diversity, equity, and inclusion as fundamental principles of our culture and success. We are dedicated to fostering a workplace where everyone feels welcome and respected, regardless of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, hair length or any other legally protected status by law.

Our commitment to diversity and inclusion means we strive to attract, develop, and retain a workforce that reflects the varied communities we serve. We believe that diverse perspectives drive innovation and strengthen our ability to create cutting-edge cybersecurity solutions. At Horizon3.ai, every team member is valued and supported in an environment that encourages personal and professional growth.

We welcome candidates from all backgrounds and experiences, and we encourage all qualified individuals to apply. Come be a part of Horizon3.ai, where your unique contributions are recognized, and your potential is limitless.

Other Duties

Application Note

title: Stage of Afstuderen: Toepassing van Augmented Reality
description:
Wat ga je doen?

Binnen Service & Support onderzoeken we hoe Augmented Reality (AR) kan bijdragen aan een efficiëntere en effectievere dienstverlening. Nieuwe technologieën bieden steeds meer mogelijkheden om klanten en monteurs op afstand te ondersteunen en stilstand van machines te beperken. Wij willen inzicht krijgen in welke toepassingen voor Voortman relevant zijn en hoe deze structureel ingezet kunnen worden binnen onze serviceorganisatie.

Tijdens deze stage onderzoek je de technische en organisatorische mogelijkheden van Augmented Reality binnen service en remote support. Je analyseert verschillende toepassingsmogelijkheden, waaronder het gebruik van een RealWear Smart Glass voor ondersteuning op afstand. Daarnaast onderzoek je welke procesveranderingen nodig zijn om AR succesvol te implementeren en welke voordelen dit kan opleveren voor de kwaliteit, snelheid en efficiëntie van onze serviceprocessen.

Je werkzaamheden bestaan onder andere uit:

  • Het onderzoeken van de mogelijkheden van Augmented Reality binnen customer service, remote support en field service;

  • Het analyseren van de inzet van de RealWear Smart Glass voor het ondersteunen van monteurs en klanten op afstand;

  • Het in kaart brengen van benodigde procesveranderingen voor de implementatie van Smart Glasses;

  • Het bepalen van mogelijke procesverbeteringen op het gebied van efficiëntie, reactietijd en servicekwaliteit.

Het eindresultaat van de opdracht is een onderbouwd implementatieplan waarmee Voortman de inzet van Augmented Reality binnen haar serviceorganisatie kan beoordelen en verder ontwikkelen.


Wij vragen

  • Een HBO- of WO-opleiding in de richting van Bedrijfskunde, Technische Bedrijfskunde, Applicatie Technologie of vergelijkbaar.

Wij bieden

  • Een vergoeding: €600,- per maand;

  • Reiskostenvergoeding: zodat jij geen onnodige kosten maakt;

  • Apparatuur en materialen: bijvoorbeeld een laptop, speciaal gereedschap of software;

  • Ervaren coach: goede begeleiding is belangrijk en dus krijg je een vaste coach om je te ondersteunen;

  • Ruimte voor persoonlijke ontwikkeling.

Over Voortman

Wat in 1968 begon in een kippenschuur in Rijssen, is uitgegroeid tot wereldspeler in CNC-staalbewerkingsmachines. Met een team van meer dan 750 collega’s wereldwijd ontwikkelen en bouwen we niet alleen high-end machines, maar ook slimme software en service waarop klanten kunnen vertrouwen. Deze 3 krachtige bouwstenen maken ons Twentse, internationale familiebedrijf uniek.

title: Senior Software Engineer (PHP, TypeScript, Node.js) m/w/d
description:
Nicht jede Heldentat ist laut. 22.000+ Unternehmen verlassen sich auf easybill, oft ohne es zu merken. Wir sorgen dafür, dass Rechnungen, Prozesse und Integrationen im Alltag einfach laufen. Remote-first, technisch anspruchsvoll, mit viel Ownership. Wenn du Systeme bauen willst, die echte Arbeit erleichtern:

Willkommen bei easybill.

Du bekommst klare Prioritäten, kurze Wege und genug Raum, um Dinge wirklich sauber zu lösen. Keine Meeting-Karaoke. Keine Konzern-Polonaise. Kein „Wir brauchen dafür noch sieben Freigaben“. Dafür: Fokus, Verantwortung, gute Tools und Menschen, die Probleme lieber lösen als verwalten.

Das ideale Profil? Du bringst tiefe PHP-/Symfony-Erfahrung mit, bist in TypeScript sattelfest und hast Lust, wie ein Founding Engineer Verantwortung zu übernehmen: pragmatisch, sauber, mit Blick fürs Ganze. Wenn dein Profil nicht jedes Kästchen erfüllt, du aber ein außergewöhnlich starker Engineer bist: Bewirb dich trotzdem und zeig uns, was du gebaut hast.

Aufgaben

Wir sind ein sehr motiviertes Engineering-Team mit viel Ownership und kurzen Wegen. Als Teil davon baust du neue Features, löst Skalierungsprobleme und übernimmst Verantwortung für komplette Projekte – von der Idee bis zum sauberen Betrieb.

Wir suchen Menschen, die nicht nur Tickets abarbeiten, sondern Systeme verstehen, verbessern und die E-Rechnungslandschaft aktiv mitgestalten wollen.

Unsere Hauptanwendung ist in PHP und TypeScript geschrieben. Im Bereich E-Rechnung betreiben wir zusätzlich Microservices auf der JVM mit Java und Kotlin. Dazu kommen MySQL bzw. Percona XtraDB Cluster, TiDB, Elasticsearch, Redis, MinIO, Docker und weitere Tools, die man braucht, wenn 22.000+ Unternehmen sich täglich auf stabile Prozesse verlassen. Sicherer Umgang mit mehreren Programmiersprachen ist für diese Rolle wichtig.

  • Du arbeitest eigenständig, motiviert und selbstorganisiert. Wir investieren gern in gute Kolleginnen und Kollegen – und haben gleichzeitig hohe Erwartungen
  • Du entwickelst Backend-Features mit PHP 8.x und Symfony: Domänenlogik, APIs und Schnittstellen in einer über 18 Jahre gewachsenen, datenlastigen Codebasis
  • Du arbeitest im Frontend mit TypeScript, React und TanStack an modernen Oberflächen und produktnahen Workflows
  • Du entwickelst Node.js-Services für ausgewählte Bereiche unserer Plattform mit TypeScript und Next.js
  • Du arbeitest an JVM-Microservices mit Java und Kotlin im Bereich E-Rechnung.
  • Du migrierst Daten, refactorst bestehende Module und modernisierst gewachsene PHP-Bereiche Schritt für Schritt sauber weiter
  • Du gehst tief in Fehleranalyse und Debugging, wenn Systeme nicht so laufen, wie sie sollen
  • Du nutzt KI als echten Produktivitätshebel. Claude Code ist bei uns kein Spielzeug, sondern Teil des Engineering-Alltags – und wir erwarten, dass du intensiv damit arbeitest
  • Je nach Thema arbeitest du auch an Infrastruktur und lokalen dockerisierten Entwicklungsumgebungen mit

Qualifikation

Grundsätzlich musst du nicht alles können. Wichtiger ist: Du kannst zeigen, dass du in deinem aktuellen Technologie-Stack richtig tief drin bist, gute technische Entscheidungen triffst und dich schnell in neue Systeme einarbeitest.

Unser Stack ist anspruchsvoll, aber du bekommst klare Prioritäten, gute Tools und ein Team, das Wissen teilt – wir erwarten dafür Eigenverantwortung, Lernstärke und den Anspruch, Dinge sauber zu lösen.

  • Du hast tiefe, eigenverantwortliche Kenntnisse in der Softwareentwicklung mit PHP und Symfony auf Senior-Level – mit sauberem Domain-Design, Testing und Performance in einer großen, langlebigen Codebasis. Je nach Schwerpunkt bringst du zusätzlich TypeScript/React mit

At BeReal, we are dedicated to authenticity in social media. By encouraging users to share unfiltered moments, we foster genuine connections and celebrate real life. We are now an international team of 70+ and have 40M+ monthly active users. Backed by Voodoo, our team is fully focused on scaling BeReal into an iconic social network used by hundreds of millions.

Role

We are looking for a talented iOS Engineer to join our Monetization team, where you will focus on building and optimizing revenue-generating features while maintaining the authentic experience that makes BeReal special.

You will be responsible for:

  • Designing, implementing, and maintaining scalable iOS monetization features (ads formats, sponsored content, premium features) in a fast-paced, high-impact environment.

  • Collaborating with cross-functional teams (designers, product managers, data analysts, backend engineers, adOps team) to build innovative monetization solutions that respect user experience.

  • Building the bridge between advertisers/partners and our users, ensuring monetization feels native and non-intrusive.

  • Optimizing performance and stability of monetization features to ensure seamless integration with the core BeReal experience.

  • Analyzing user behavior, A/B tests results, and business metrics to iterate on monetization strategies.

  • Ensuring a high-quality, authentic user experience through thoughtful technical solutions.

  • Contributing to and upholding best practices in code quality, design, and development processes.

  • Continuously innovating and improving the iOS tech stack (Swift, SwiftUI).

You'll work alongside AI tools that amplify your creativity and streamline your day-to-day.

Profile

  • Strong iOS programming skills (5+ years experience).

  • Solid knowledge in Swift, SwiftUI and UIKit.

  • Familiarity with Clean Architecture principles and separation of concerns.

  • Experience building monetization features, ads products, or consumer-facing products is a strong plus.

  • Interest for analytics and data-first mindset to measure impact and iterate.

  • Swile Lunch voucher

  • Gymlib (100% covered by Voodoo)

title: Backend Engineer – Real-Time Video
description:
About Stream

Stream powers real-time Chat, Video, Activity Feeds, and AI Moderation for more than 1 billion end users across 4,000+ apps, from Strava and Bumble to eBay and Patreon. Our platform processes billions of API requests per month and supports applications with millions of concurrent users, while delivering highly reliable, low-latency services and a great developer experience.

The role

We're looking for a Staff Backend Engineer to join Stream on our mission of elevating the quality of apps for billions of users globally. You'll own the technical direction of Stream Video's media plane and the infrastructure it runs on.

This is a full-time role, hybrid with 3 days a week in our Amsterdam office, or remote from anywhere in the EU.

What you'll work on

Stream Video runs on an SFU we built in Go on top of Pion, plus ingest and recording fleets, all on a global edge network we own across more than one cloud. Nobody at Stream has owned this media plane end to end before. Our central infrastructure team is tuned for request-based services, and video breaks in different ways: live sessions can't be dropped, bandwidth is the biggest cost, and placement is the main lever. That's why this is a Staff role. You'll set the direction for the video backend and its infrastructure with your own roadmap, reporting to our Director of Engineering with a direct line to our CTO. The Video SDK teams own the client side, and you'll work closely with them and with infrastructure. Part of the fleet is mid-move to Kubernetes.

Job responsibilities:

  • Architecture: write the architecture and roadmap for Stream Video's backend and media infrastructure, and decide what ships.

  • Scale livestreaming: architect the SFU and media pipeline (WHIP, WHEP, RTMP, SRT, HLS, SVC), including the path from WebRTC to CDN-backed HLS for very large audiences.

  • Own the fleet: reliability, autoscaling, placement, rollouts, observability and cost for long-lived sessions across clouds, with cost per gigabyte as a first-class metric.

  • Gate production changes: define the validation that decides which changes, including AI-generated ones, reach live media, using behaviour tests on realistic networks, nightly telemetry scans and a public quality benchmark.

  • Take the final escalation: handle the hardest quality, latency and production incidents, and work with enterprise customers on advanced integrations.

  • Raise the bar: mentor senior engineers through design review, code review and hiring.

About you

You've owned systems where a dropped session or a bad rollout is visible to users within seconds, and you think about cost and reliability as much as features. You'd rather write the hard design doc than wait for one. A founder background is an asset here. The team is small, so you'll still write and review plenty of code. If you're looking for a large organisation with a platform team to hand problems to, or a management track, this role won't suit you.

You have:

title: Founding Growth - Alan Precision
description:
Health can’t wait.

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

⭐ Alan Precision: why this exists

Your body knows before you do. The signals are there years before symptoms. And yet, in 2026, the system around us isn't catching them.

50% of non-communicable diseases (cardiovascular disease, type 2 diabetes, many cancers) are preventable with lifestyle changes, and we're not capturing them. Western countries have seen healthspan flatline for years, meaning we live longer, but not better. 46% of Europeans report mental health issues. The kind of deep, personalised health reading that could change this has been reserved for the few who could afford a 3,000€ check-up, and built for filing reports rather than changing lives.

We don't accept that.

Alan Precision is our bet on advanced prevention as the new norm of care. We combine biology, wearables, medical history, and lifestyle context, read it all as a connected system with AI supervised by physicians, and turn the result into a personalised protocol the member actually executes across sleep, nutrition, movement, stress, and supplementation. Then we retest, learn, and adapt. Health is a moving target. We move with it.

Our ambition: make Alan Precision the reference for advanced prevention in Europe by 2030.

⭐ The Founding Growth opportunity

Alan Precision is live, with fast week-over-week growth. Now we need to turn a new category into a habit: hundreds of thousands of customers in the coming years, and a measurable impact on their health. You will be the first growth and go-to-market person on the crew, accountable for two numbers: how many members subscribe to Precision, and how many stay, retest and renew.

The crew was launched by the founding team of ARO, acquired by Alan in 2026, to move fast and apply their learnings from building a preventive health company.

It is a unique playground. You get the means of one of France's biggest scale-ups (1M+ members reachable from day one, an ecosystem of products like Mo, Play and Clinic, and a brand carried by ambassadors like Kylian Mbappé) with the culture and pace of a fast-growing startup: small crew, short loops, everything still to invent.

🔭 Scope: Three go-to-market engines

1. Direct-to-member: turn Alan's 1M+ members into Precision subscribers.

Offering paid services that members subscribe to by themselves inside Alan is a pretty new go-to-market for us, and you invent it.

  • Build the CRM and lifecycle engine: segments, triggers, sequences, in-app moments.

  • Use product data to decide who to push Precision to, when and where: which actions, traits or life moments make it relevant, and which do not.

  • Position Precision inside the surfaces of other product crews (Mo, Play, Clinic, Shop), with their teams and push the right message at the right time.

  • Own recurrence: activation after the first check-up, retests, renewals, reactivation. Acquisition without retention does not count.

2. B2B: get Alan's client companies to offer Precision to their employees.

Almost everything is to define: business model, offer format, pricing logic, sales motion.

  • Work with our B2B Marketing team to understand the constraints of our Sales and Account Management teams, give them the right pitch and materials, and set the right targets with them.

  • Meet HR buyers yourself to learn what makes them pay.

3. Beyond Alan: take Precision to the open market.

Once the internal engine runs:

  • Apply the full B2C health and e-commerce playbook to acquire users that are not insured by Alan

  • Your levers will be numerous, across paid acquisition, influence, partnerships, brand.

Across all three:

  • Create demand in a market that is still being created. Talk to members every week, define the value proposition and the messages that make people want advanced prevention, and push for the product changes that go with them.

  • Build a brand people want, and explain it simply. Make advanced prevention desirable and easy to understand, with our Brand team, without overpromising.

  • Say what can be said. Health communication is regulated: medical biology, health claims, influencer rules, use of health data for targeting. You work with our medical and legal teams and turn these constraints into sharper, more credible messages.

  • Measure and decide. Funnels, cohorts, holdouts, channel performance. Pick the next bet, cut what does not work, share what we learned.

  • Own it end to end. From the idea of a strategy to the campaign live in production: you design it, write it, build it, ship it and iterate on it yourself. Sharp copywriting is a core part of the job.

⭐ Is it you we're looking for?

  • Fluent in French and English.

  • You have grown a B2C product from its early days. Ideally as the first growth or go-to-market person, on a subscription in health, wellbeing or e-commerce. You can tell us which channels you picked, which ones you cut, and why.

  • A creative Swiss army knife who prioritises. You can do a bit of everything and you find channels and angles nobody has thought of yet. You know the job is to pick the right one, execute it, measure it and move to the next.

  • Lifecycle and CRM at scale. Customer.io, Braze or equivalent: segmentation, behavioural triggers, in-app moments.

  • Analytical rigour. You read a funnel, build a cohort, set up a holdout and call a result. You measure success in subscribers, retention and revenue.

  • Hands-on, and a great writer. You love taking an idea all the way to production yourself: the strategy, the copy, the campaign, the dashboard. You write well and fast, and you turn a complex medical topic into a clear, desirable promise.

  • Customer-obsessed. You talk to members every week and you are just as comfortable in front of an HR director.

  • Fluent with AI. You build with AI every day: assets, copy variants, segments, analyses and even building your own tools. You use it to go faster, and you keep your judgment on what ships.

  • Driven by health, and rigorous about it. Health matters to you, and when something blocks, you find a way. You make people want to act with messages that hold up in front of a physician.

Nice to haves

  • Experience with regulated health communication (claims, health data, medical services).

  • B2B2C, employee benefits or HR tech.

  • Paid acquisition and influencer marketing in B2C.

  • Pricing and packaging of subscription offers.

  • You own your own health: Whoop, Oura, blood tests, supplements are no secret for you.

🌍 How we work

  • Location: Paris

  • Remote work: We offer remote work flexibility, but we value in-person collaboration.

🎯 Important note: we hire people, not roles.

If you're excited about this opportunity but don't check every box, we'd love to hear from you. Everyone, no matter how underrepresented, should feel free to apply, as it can only bring learnings or success.
If you identify yourself as a woman: Did you know that research shows women often apply only when meeting 100% of requirements?
Remember, this is just a guide, not a checklist. We'll be thrilled to receive your application!

🔖 Check out our About Alan and Career pages, as well as our Medium, blog and Glassdoor page for more info.

You want to know more about Alan?

  • 🙌 Perks & Benefits: Alaners are provided with a stimulating environment and perks ensuring they are happy, efficient and spend only high-quality time with co-workers.

  • 🤘 A strong culture: People joining Alan are often surprised and delighted by our innovative working method. We have a set of cultural values that guide our approach to work.

title: GTM Engineer
description:
About Kernel

Agents are starting to sell, buy and operate on behalf of companies. But before an agent can close a deal, qualify an account, route a lead or assess risk, it has to answer a basic question: which company is this?

Today, that answer is messy, and no one answers it reliably. Business identity lives across CRMs, ERPs and third-party datasets full of duplicates, missing parent companies, stale addresses and incorrect enrichment. The cost shows up across the enterprise: sales teams miss revenue opportunities because they lack the right account context; operations teams take on avoidable exposure because risk signals are fragmented or wrong; and finance teams end up chasing, writing off, or defaulting on bad debt that should have been caught earlier.

Humans have worked around that mess for years. Agents cannot. They need a reliable business identity layer they can trust.

Kernel is building that layer: the business registry for agents. We issue a permanent Kernel ID for every business, plus the context an agent needs to act on it. Ops, data and revenue teams at Gong, Legora, Mistral, Canva and Notion already use Kernel on their own systems. Agents are next, and there will be far more of them.

We have raised $20M from top VCs and operators at Plaid, OpenAI, Slack and others, and we are growing 12x YoY.

The Role

We're looking for a GTM Engineer to build the systems that take Kernel to $100m+ ARR. You'll own the infrastructure behind how we find, sell to and grow customers, from Salesforce and outbound to forecasting, renewals and expansion.

This is a hands-on builder role, not a traditional RevOps support function. You'll work like a product engineer for GTM: find the biggest constraint on growth, turn a messy commercial problem into a working system, ship it quickly and improve it using real results. You do not need to be a software engineer, but you do need to be able to build with Salesforce, Clay, APIs, automation platforms and AI tools rather than waiting for someone else to do it.

You'll also be Kernel's own internal customer, using Kernel to build an AI-native revenue engine, pressure-test the product in real workflows and turn what you learn into useful feedback for Product and Engineering.

You'll report to Arvin Ashrafi, Head of Finance & Operations, and work closely with Sales leadership and the wider GTM team.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Build a better outbound engine: improve account targeting, signals, enrichment, prioritization, personalization, sequencing and measurement so the team consistently reaches the right companies at the right time

  • Make the GTM team more productive: automate repetitive work across account research, meeting preparation, follow-ups, CRM hygiene and handoffs so BDRs, AEs and Account Managers spend more time with customers

  • Run the revenue operating infrastructure: own the systems behind pipeline management, forecasting, funnel reporting, quota planning, GTM incentive compensation, renewals and expansion

  • Set the rules of engagement: own account assignment and routing, settle ownership disputes, and make sure every meeting booked and held is captured and credited to the right person

  • Improve how revenue work moves through Kernel: build reliable routing, attribution, account assignment and cross-functional handoffs, resolve edge cases and make performance visible

  • Be Kernel's own internal customer: deploy Kernel on our CRM, use it to improve our GTM data and workflows, and turn what you learn into useful feedback for Product and Engineering

What You Bring

  • 3-5 years of relevant experience: you have worked in RevOps, Sales Ops or GTM Engineering at a high-growth Series B-E SaaS company and owned meaningful parts of the revenue engine end to end

  • Deep Salesforce fluency: you understand objects, record types, fields, formulas, flows, validation rules, permissions, reports and data migration. You can reason about architecture and debug production behavior

  • Strong GTM building ability: you have built useful systems with Clay, APIs, automation platforms and AI tools, and you know how to move from a rough idea to a reliable workflow that people adopt

  • Commercial judgment: you understand how accounts become meetings, meetings become pipeline, pipeline is qualified and forecast, and won revenue flows into implementation, expansion, renewal and retention

  • Strong data instincts: you can turn fragmented information into trustworthy workflows, measure what is working and create feedback loops that improve performance over time

  • Clear, low-ego communication: you can turn a messy request into a crisp decision, explain trade-offs to non-technical teams, push back constructively and drive adoption through influence rather than authority

It is a plus if you also have:

  • Experience supporting an enterprise sales motion with multi-stakeholder deals and MEDDPICC

  • Experience with renewals, expansion, compensation, quota setting or planning

  • Familiarity with Gong, sales engagement platforms and modern enrichment or intent tooling

  • Experience building operational controls around LLM- or agent-powered workflows

⚠️ This role may not be for you if you:

  • Prefer strategy and recommendations over configuring systems, cleaning data, investigating edge cases and debugging workflows yourself

  • Need outlined requirements or stable priorities before you can make progress

  • See GTM Engineering primarily as CRM administration or ticket fulfillment rather than a revenue-generating function

❌ This role is definitely not for you if you:

  • Are not comfortable taking broad ownership of a function

  • Prefer a predictable, low-intensity environment

  • Want to protect a 9-to-6 or a mostly remote setup. We are in the office together 4-5 days a week and the pace is high

What We Offer

We will do our best to offer you a ride of a lifetime. It will not be easy, but it will be thrilling.

  • 🗓️ 24 days holiday per year + bank holidays

  • 🍼 Generous parental leave policy

  • 💼 Pension plan

  • 💻 Top-spec equipment and central London office

  • 🎉 Team events and dinners

  • 🚀 Work directly with the founders to build the systems that power an AI-native revenue engine

  • 🏆 High-autonomy, high-trust environment with a small team shipping at pace

❤️ Team

Arvin Ashrafi, Head of Finance & Operations

Amin Shafi, BizOps Associate

Dave Bentham, Head of Sales

🎫 Visas & Relocation

Not offered for this role.

Interview Process

  • Stage 2: Technical: In-person case interview

title: Senior Fullstack Engineer
description:
Join BLP and help make the world’s business processes autonomous!

Our agentic platform helps finance and operations teams worldwide remove manual work from their core business processes, so work runs end-to-end with greater control and significant productivity gains.

Today, over 550 enterprise customers use BLP across 1,300+ deployed projects. In the processes we automate, customers achieve productivity improvements of 5 to 10 times.

To date, BLP remains majority employee-owned, with Goldman Sachs holding a minority stake as a growth investor. Our success is driven by deep expertise in technology and business processes, a superior product with strong product-market fit, reflected in an expanding customer base that includes Fortune 500 companies.

BLP is one of Switzerland's fastest-growing SaaS scale-ups; we are now entering our next phase of growth. From our headquarters on Zürich's Bahnhofstrasse, we're expanding globally, with a growing presence across Europe and North America.

Join us and help make autonomous operations the new standard.

The team

At blp, dedicated engineering teams own individual products such as invoices, customer orders, and order confirmations. The Platform Team owns what all of them are built on: shared services and APIs, the data access layer, and the component and design system that shape how the product looks and behaves.

The team's focus has been the frontend platform, and we are now deliberately extending that ownership deeper into the stack. You would be central to that shift, with real influence over how the platform layer gets defined rather than inheriting someone else's blueprint.

 

About the role

  • What you'll do and for whom. You build and run the core backend service our product teams rely on, from its APIs and persistence layer to email, user provisioning, and cross-tenant capabilities for large enterprises. Through those teams, your work reaches the 20'000+ people who use our Purchase-to-Pay and Order-to-Cash agents every day.

  • Where you'll work. You join the Platform Team, about 10 engineers. At BLP, platform means the core of our product, not internal infrastructure: the shared services, data access layer, and design system that every product runs on. You work closely with the senior backend engineer who owns these areas today, in a large production Go codebase with well-established patterns.

  • What success looks like. In your first year, you own one core area end-to-end, for example, user provisioning, outbound email, cross-tenant capabilities, analytics, or workflow configuration, from the Go service to the customer using it.

 

What you'll do

  • Build the service that product teams build on. Design, build, and evolve the core APIs behind document processing, approval workflows, administration, and analytics, with clear contracts so product teams can ship on top of them without workarounds.

  • Own the persistence layer. Each tenant has its own isolated MySQL database. You evolve the abstraction product teams build on (a tenant-scoped unit of work, typed repositories, and shared type-safe querying) so that isolation, transactions, and permissions are right by default.

  • Scale BLP for large enterprises. Extend our cross-tenant capabilities so customers with many subsidiaries and business units can manage users, permissions, and documents across all of them from one place, correctly, securely, and fast.

  • Own email, in and out. Own our email document ingestion and outbound email services, including the audit trail and its UI.

  • Make setup self-service. Turn manual SSO, SCIM, and email setups into migration tools and admin UIs that customers and project managers can run on their own.

  • Work with customers. Join onboarding calls with customer IT teams and project managers, get their setups running, and turn what you learn into better tooling.

  • Own it end-to-end. From the Go service through the React UI to production, including tracing, metrics, and incident analysis after it ships.

Tech stack: Go, React/TypeScript, MySQL, Redis, Temporal, Kubernetes on GCP and AWS, GitHub CI/CD, and OpenTelemetry with Grafana, Prometheus, Tempo, and Parca for observability.

 

We're excited about you because

  • You have 4+ years of experience as a software engineer, with most of that time spent building and operating backend systems in production.

  • You have 2+ years of professional Go experience, writing services that run in production, not side projects.

  • You've designed a backend service or API that other teams depended on, and kept it reliable and evolvable as usage grew.

  • You work well across teams. You align with product, integration, and infrastructure teams on contracts, priorities, and rollouts, and you can explain technical trade-offs to people who aren't engineers.

  • You improve existing production systems step by step, and you know when a rewrite isn't worth it.

  • You have strong fundamentals in type systems, composition, testing, and clean architecture, and you're comfortable working in a codebase built on functional patterns.

  • You're fullstack where it counts: you build on the components and design system our frontend experts maintain to ship admin UIs quickly, even though the backend is where you do your deepest work.

  • You think in products and take ownership. You translate business problems into precise specifications, weigh cost against benefit, work directly with customers when a setup needs it, and stay responsible for what you ship after it goes live.

 

Strong plus

  • Experience with distributed systems, Kubernetes, Temporal, or cloud infrastructure.

  • Experience with user provisioning (SCIM) and SSO (OIDC).

  • Experience running multi-tenant systems.

  • Domain knowledge in ERP, finance, procurement, or supply chain processes, or German language skills.

What you'll get

  • Ownership of visible outcomes. The areas you own decide how fast enterprise customers go live and how well BLP scales with them.

  • Impact at scale. Every improvement you ship to the product core multiplies across all product teams and the 20'000+ people who use BLP daily.

  • Senior scope from day one. You'll lead technical initiatives and mentor engineers on a team that is actively growing its backend ownership.

Learn more about BLP and our values at blp.digital/company/careers.

Please note: Hybrid work in London office, or remote in wider UK and Europe.

title: AI Native Product Engineer
description:
At Brevo, we’re not just building a CRM. With our technology, we’re helping millions of organizations build lasting relationships with their customers.

From emails and SMS to WhatsApp, Chat, and Marketing Automation, our tools are intuitive, powerful, and built to scale with every ambition. We give businesses a clear view of the customer journey, so they can focus on what matters: connection.

As a certified B Corp, we’re proud to grow with purpose, committed to high standards of social and environmental impact, not just performance.

Today, more than 500,000 businesses across 180 countries—from NGOs like Amnesty International to global brands like Carrefour, eBay, Louis Vuitton, and Michelin—trust Brevo to engage their audiences, cut through complexity, and deliver results. Our reliable technology and 75+ integrations help them create unparalleled customer experiences, without the usual tech headaches.

We recently exceeded 200m ARR and reached a major milestone by becoming a Unicorn, backed by strong growth and global expansion - and we’re just getting started!

The role:
 

Join us as a Product Engineer to build a new product within Brevo called Brevo OS.

Brevo OS is a startup inside Brevo: a team of six, a product we started from an empty repository earlier this year, and the feel of a small company within the big one. The product works, the first customer deployments are beginning, and a great deal is still undecided — so the people who join us now will shape what it becomes.
It's an AI-native operating system for small businesses: a system of agents that helps a solopreneur, a hair salon or a building contractor run their whole business — clients, contracts and signature, invoicing, their website, their inbox. Modules get added the way an ERP grows, except the whole thing is built around agents from the ground up.


Your Impact at Brevo:
  • Turn a very high level business need into something real : understand the function, define the users, the smallest useful version, the entities and their lifecycles, the permissions and constraints that matter, and what to build versus integrate
  • Decide which of our platform primitives to extend rather than reinvent, then build it, ship it, watch it in production, and improve it
  • Work across product management, frontend, backend, data modelling, infrastructure, and AI. Everyone arrived with a specialism and nobody is confined to theirs; product thinking and business analysis is part of everyone’s job
  • Build almost entirely through coding agents: Claude Code is the workflow, not a pilot running alongside it, for implementation, codebase exploration, documentation, debugging, and operations
  • Decompose problems into work an agent can actually execute, give it context without over-constraining it, and tell the difference between correct and merely plausible
  • Verify with tests and instrumentation, not vibes, and keep a large generated codebase coherent
  • Work day to day in TypeScript, Kubernetes, and agentic frameworks

    • Who you are:
  • Around 2-5 years of professional engineering experience. We care more about your slope than your years.
  • Real depth in something, and no attachment to staying there. Bring what you're genuinely strong at — the team compounds those — and expect to spend a good part of your time well outside it.
  • Coding agents already central to how you work. Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, something equivalent. Not "I've generated the Unit Tests" — real delegation of substantial work, and real review of what comes back. Scepticism about generated output is a feature of this job, not a problem.
  • Evidence you've owned a problem, not just implemented a ticket — something you helped define, drove, shipped and then lived with in production. Product questions are your questions too.
  • At your best when the brief is one sentence and the plan is still moving. We're learning what this product is, so priorities change often. The mission doesn't.
  • English. We're an international team working across France and India, and English is our working language. French is not required.
    • If you don't meet all the requirements above but believe this opportunity matches your expectations and experience, we still encourage you to apply!

    Why people love working at Brevo:
  • A place to grow, together: Join an international team in a bright, collaborative office located in a vibrant neighbourhood.
  • Practical perks for everyday balance: RTT days off, 50% public transport reimbursement, Sustainable Mobility Package (whether you ride a classic bike or go electric, we support your choice to commute greener) and daily Swile meal vouchers (€12.50/day).
  • Learning, every step of the way: Access to English classes and 155,000+ courses on Udemy, plus a strong internal culture of knowledge-sharing and support.
  • Flexible for life: A remote-friendly setup, budget to support your home workspace, and relocation assistance for international talents.
  • Wellbeing that works: Top-notch private healthcare (70% covered), 6-week second-parent leave, extra time off if your child is sick and needs you, and several prevention, health and wellbeing services on the Welii platform.
  • A culture that cares: From inter-office trips to regular team events, there are plenty of ways to connect beyond your day-to-day. You'll also find active social, green, and LGBTQIA+ communities, plus Work Council benefits via Leeto, all here to support what matters to you, inside and outside of work.

  • Live Use case (2 hours)
  • Final interview with the Global VP & People Business Partner (30 min)

title: Forward Deployed Software Engineer
description:
A World-Changing Company
 
Palantir builds the world’s leading software for data-driven decisions and operations. By bringing the right data to the people who need it, our platforms empower our partners to develop lifesaving drugs, forecast supply chain disruptions, locate missing children, and more.

The Role
 
Forward Deployed Software Engineers (FDSEs) work directly with customers to quickly understand their greatest problems and design and implement solutions to use data against them. Our customers rely on Palantir’s platforms for some of their most critical operations, and projects often start with an open ended question like “Why are we delaying so many flights?” or “How can we better identify instances of money laundering?” As an FDSE, you’ll apply your problem solving ability, creativity, and technical skills to help organizations use their data to drive a real impact in the world. You’ll have the opportunity to gain rare insight into and contribute to some of the world’s most important industries and institutions.

As an FDSE, your responsibilities look similar to those of a startup CTO: you’ll work in small teams with minimal supervision and own end-to-end execution of high stakes projects. Your day might span discussing architecture with fellow engineers, wrangling massive-scale data, coding a custom web app, speaking with customer executives, or establishing strategy for your team.

Whether you aspire to be an entrepreneur or an engineering leader, we believe Palantir is the best place — with the best colleagues — to learn how. You’ll learn how to unpack a problem and understand the costs and consequences of its solution. You’ll learn new technologies and languages, and even develop them yourself. You’ll work autonomously and make decisions independently, within a community that will support and challenge you as you grow and develop.

Core Responsibilities
  • Impact: We take on meaningful and challenging projects that change the world for the better.
  • Ownership: We see projects through from beginning to end, working through any obstacles we may encounter.
  • Collaboration: We work internally with people from a variety of backgrounds — such as other FDSEs, product teams, and Deployment Strategists. We also work externally with our customers, often on site, to understand and solve their problems.
  • Trust: We trust each other to effectively manage time and priorities and give people the space to think for themselves.
  • Growth: We encourage ourselves and our peers to seek new challenges and opportunities for growth, as well as find new ways to innovate and share knowledge.
  • Learning: We often face entirely novel problems where we need to pick up a lot of new knowledge and learn how to use it to make progress. We believe experiential learning is one of the best teachers.

    • What We Value
  • Strong engineering background, preferred in fields such as Computer Science, Mathematics, Software Engineering, Physics, and Data Science.
  • A highly analytical mindset and eagerness to solve technical problems with data structures, storage systems, cloud infrastructure, front-end frameworks, and other technical tools.
  • Experience or interest in working with and using large scale data to solve valuable business problems.
  • Strong coder with demonstrated proficiency in programming languages such as Python, Java, C++, TypeScript/JavaScript, or similar.
  • Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively in teams of technical and non-technical individuals, and comfortable working in a rapidly changing environment with dynamic objectives and iteration with users.
  • Ability to continuously learn, work independently, and make decisions with minimal supervision.
  • Willingness and interest to travel as needed to client sites. Ability to travel 25-50% preferred, but may vary by team and location.

    • What We Require
  • Fluency in German
  • Security clearance or the ability to obtain a clearance.
    • Life at Palantir
     
    We want every Palantirian to achieve their best outcomes, that’s why we celebrate individuals’ strengths, skills, and interests, from your first interview to your longterm growth, rather than rely on traditional career ladders. Paying attention to the needs of our community enables us to optimize our opportunities to grow and helps ensure many pathways to success at Palantir. Promoting health and well-being across all areas of Palantirians’ lives is just one of the ways we’re investing in our community. Learn more at Life at Palantir and note that our offerings may vary by region.
     
    In keeping consistent with Palantir’s values and culture, we believe employees are “better together” and in-person work affords the opportunity for more creative outcomes. Therefore, we encourage employees to work from our offices to foster connectivity and innovation. Many teams do offer hybrid options (WFH a day or two a week), allowing our employees to strike the right trade-off for their personal productivity. Based on business need, there are a few roles that allow for “Remote” work on an exceptional basis. If you are applying for one of these roles, you must work from the city and or country in which you are employed. If the posting is specified as Onsite, you are required to work from an office.
     
    If you want to empower the world's most important institutions, you belong here. Palantir values excellence regardless of background. We are committed to making the application and hiring process accessible to everyone and will provide a reasonable accommodation for those living with a disability. If you need an accommodation for the application or hiring process, please and let us know how we can help.
     
    Please note that you will never be asked to submit a payment or share financial information to participate in our interview process. If you suspect that you've been contacted by a scammer, we recommend you cease all communication with the individual and consider reporting them to the relevant authorities, such as the US FBI Internet Crime Complaint Center (IC3).

Als UX/UI Designer (m/w/d) mit Projektverantwortung gestaltest du diese Produkte, führst deine Designprojekte selbst und bist Ansprechperson für unsere Partner, wenn es um Nutzererlebnis geht.

Deine Aufgaben

UI/UX Design:

  • Du gestaltest Web-Anwendungen (Portale, Dashboards) und Mobile Apps für Android und iOS

  • Du führst Nutzerforschung durch und entwickelst User Flows, Wireframes, Prototypen und finale Designs

  • Du pflegst und erweiterst unser Designsystem

  • Du arbeitest eng mit der Entwicklung von der Idee bis zum Release zusammen

Projektverantwortung und Kommunikation:

  • Du führst deine Projekte: Ziele, Zeitplan, Abstimmung und Ergebnis

  • Du stellst Konzepte und Designs bei Partnern vor und holst Feedback ein

  • Du schreibst User Stories mit klaren Akzeptanzkriterien und pflegst Roadmap und Prioritäten gemeinsam mit deinen Teamkollegen aus der Entwicklung und Geschäftsführung

Qualität:

  • Du testest neue Funktionen gegen das Design und die Akzeptanzkriterien und wirkst an Usability-Evaluationen mit

Was du mitbringst

Design:

  • Mindestens drei Jahre Berufserfahrung im UX/UI Design

  • Ein Portfolio mit umgesetzten Web- und Mobile-Projekten

  • Sehr sicherer Umgang mit einem professionellen UI-Design-Tool, inklusive Komponenten und Prototyping

Verantwortung und Kommunikation:

  • Du hast mindestens ein Projekt selbst koordiniert, nicht nur daran mitgearbeitet

  • Du kannst Designentscheidungen gegenüber Partnern, Entwicklung und Geschäftsführung klar begründen

  • Du gehst offen mit Feedback um und bleibst trotzdem bei deiner Linie, wo sie für Nutzer:innen richtig ist

Ein Plus:

  • Erfahrung in regulierten Branchen (Medizintechnik, Pharma, Automotive o. ä.)

  • Kenntnisse in Barrierefreiheit (WCAG) und technisches Grundverständnis für Frontend und Mobile

  • Erfahrung mit agilen Methoden, Jira und Confluence

  • Erfahrung mit Nutzerforschung, Usability-Tests und Designsystemen

Sprachkenntnisse:

  • Weiterentwicklung: Mindestens eine Konferenz oder ein Training pro Jahr; regulatorisches Know-how vermitteln wir dir im Onboarding.

  • Kurze Entscheidungswege: Ein Team aus knapp 20 Leuten, flache Hierarchien und direkter Draht zur Geschäftsführung.

  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit der Entwicklung: Du arbeitest täglich direkt mit unseren Web- und Mobile-Entwickler:innen zusammen, ohne lange Abstimmungsketten.

Unser Bewerbungsprozess

Wir legen Wert auf einen transparenten und respektvollen Prozess:

  1. Screening-Gespräch (ca. 30 Min., remote)
    Gegenseitiges Kennenlernen, Rahmenbedingungen, erste fachliche Einordnung

  2. Fachliches Interview (ca. 90 Min., remote oder vor Ort)
    Du stellst ein bis zwei Projekte aus deinem Portfolio vor und zeigst uns eine deiner Design-Dateien. Anschließend bearbeiten wir gemeinsam eine fiktive, praxisnahe Fallstudie zu Design, Projektsteuerung und Partnerkommunikation. Eine Vorbereitung außer der Portfolio-Auswahl ist nicht nötig.

  3. Team-Kennenlernen (ca. 45 Min., idealerweise vor Ort)

Zeitrahmen: Von der Bewerbung bis zur Entscheidung planen wir etwa 2–3 Wochen. Spätestens zwei Werktage nach Eingang deiner Bewerbung melden wir uns, nach jeder Phase erhältst du zeitnah Feedback.

Noch unsicher?

Du erfüllst nicht jede Anforderung, fühlst dich aber angesprochen? Dann bewirb dich gern. Ein Lebenslauf und ein Link zu deinem Portfolio reichen uns zum Einstieg.

Wir freuen uns auf dich!

We are rebuilding the energy transaction, making it transparent and fair.

Our goal is to put power back where it belongs, in the hands of customers and to take on one of the most critical problems of our century, access to low cost electricity.

tem exists to fix a broken global energy market that’s long favoured legacy operators, intermediaries, and opaque pricing. Today’s electricity system was not designed for rapid decarbonisation, AI-driven efficiency or fair access for the actual users - businesses and generators.

We’ve built the first AI native transaction infrastructure to reinvent how electricity is bought, sold and priced. Our technology is designed to cut out the inefficient fees, automate complex market flows, and bring transparency and fairness to energy transactions at scale.

In late 2025, after extraordinary growth, we closed a $75 million Series B - led by Lightspeed Venture Partners with participation from Albion, Atomico, Allianz, Hitachi Ventures, Hitachi Ventures, Schroders Capital and others - positioning us for global expansion, deeper product innovation and category leadership.

We’re scaling internationally and building toward a future where AI-driven infrastructure is foundational to electricity markets worldwide.

Since launch, our modern utility product, known as RED, has already facilitated thousands of business customers and billions in energy transaction value, proving that modern software and AI can transform an industry built on legacy systems.

At tem, we’re not just building another energy company, we’re rearchitecting market infrastructure so that transparency, efficiency and sustainability become the default, not the exception.

🚀 The Role

We’re hiring a GTM Senior Product Marketing Manager who wants to take our product from 1-100, not 0-1 scale.

You will join the fastest growing unit inside tem. This team is obsessed about growing our SMB customers and transforming their perception of energy beyond the bill, so we can hand more money and value back in their hands.

You will be a hands-on product marketer who can bring sharp judgment and voice of customer consistently back to the table. Your focus is to grow the trial, adoption and experience of our RED product and be ruthless in those goals. Expect to solve problems on your own and with product, content and engineers whilst running your own team of expert GTM agents.

Good looks like? Every 48 hours you’ll be:

  • Speaking to a customer.

  • Shipping a campaign with Claude.

  • Launching a piece of work that directly solves a customer problem.

  • Showing the goals move forward.

You’ll be 20% in architecting, 80% in delivery.

🛠️ Responsibilities

  • User research: take control of it.

  • Assets: design and prototype assets to wow and educate our customers.

  • Demos: reinvent them.

  • Positioning and messaging: challenge and consistently redefine them.

  • Communications: untangle and re-build them.

  • Campaigns: drive promotional, time-sensitive campaigns.

✅ Requirements

Must-Haves

  • Everyone at tem works from first principles, acts autonomously and builds. For this role, we also need these, in priority order:

    • Deeply analytical. You go to the numbers first and can explain what moved and why.

    • Taste and creative edge. You know what great looks like and the work shows it.

    • Outcome-minded. You can show which of your plays moved a number and which didn’t.

    • Customer-obsessed. You start from the customer’s problem, every time.

    • Strong risk appetite. You back bets before the data is complete, and cut them fast when they fail.

🎁 Benefits & Perks

  • Stock options so everyone has ownership in our mission.

  • 25 days holiday plus public holidays. Swap public holidays for the ones that matter most to you, and enjoy your birthday off.

  • Up to £1,200 or €1,200 per year for your remote setup.

  • Bar Raiser Interview with Stakeholders.

We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, experiences, and identities, including those that are traditionally underrepresented in the tech and energy sectors. If you’re excited about this role but not sure you meet every requirement, we’d still love to hear from you. Your unique perspective could be exactly what we’re looking for.

description:
About Payflows

At Payflows, we build software that helps large companies manage and automate their payment workflows. It’s not the flashiest part of a business, but it’s one of the most critical: invoices, approvals, payments, and controls. When these things slow down, the whole company feels it.

But our ambition goes further than just building a better workflow tool.

We believe the future of finance operations is not faster clicking: it’s no clicking at all 🫳 🎤

Finance teams shouldn’t spend their days moving data from one screen to another. Software should do the operational work, and humans should focus on reviewing, approving, and making the decisions that matter.

That’s the direction we’re building toward: an agent-driven finance platform, where intelligent agents handle the repetitive tasks, and users stay in control.

We started in 2022 with a small team and a rough first version of the product. Three years later, we’re working with major companies across France, the UK, and the US while choosing to keep our team small and human-sized.

We moved fast, shipped a lot, and not everything was built in a perfect way. But it helped us learn quickly, sign real customers, and prove that the problem we’re solving truly matters.

In 2024, investors trusted us with a $25M Series A. That gives us the chance to keep growing while also strengthening our foundations and building the system that will power this agent-driven future.

Today, we’re about 35 people from many different countries, and we’re looking for a few amazing humans to join the next chapter. 🤗

🚀 What you’ll actually do

You’ll help build a product that real finance teams rely on every day.

For us, engineering is not just about clean code, it’s about reliability, clarity, and trust, especially when money and automation are involved.

In a typical week, you might:

  • Design and implement new services for a product feature.

  • Refactor an early service to make it more robust.

  • Investigate a performance or production issue.

  • Work with product and frontend to shape a new feature.

  • Review code and help teammates improve.

  • Build backend tools that our AI agents use to perform real finance operations.

  • Design safe, deterministic workflows where agents propose actions and humans review them.

Your time will be split between building new features and improving what already exists. Both matter.

You won’t just build endpoints. You’ll help shape the execution layer that our agents rely on: the APIs, data models, and workflows that let them act safely in production.

You’ll work closely with product, frontend, and customer-facing teams. We expect engineers to take ownership of parts of the system and help make them more reliable over time.

💻 Our current tech reality

Our stack evolves based on our challenges, but we care more about good design than trendy tools 🙏

Python is our core language. It helps us move fast, keep the code readable, and fits naturally with our AI-driven approach. A growing part of the system is built around agents that use our backend as a set of reliable, deterministic tools.

  • Core language: Python

  • Backend: FastAPI + Pydantic

  • Data: PostgreSQL

  • Infra: AWS, serverless when it makes sense

  • Performance: some Rust for critical paths

  • Architecture: multi-service backend, simple enough to reason about

Some parts of the system are clean and well-tested. Others were built quickly and need love. That’s the phase we’re in.

Over the next year, we’ll focus on:

  • Turning core workflows into reliable tools for our agents

  • Simplifying services

  • Improving tests and observability

  • Making performance more predictable

  • Cleaning up early code

We know we’re not perfect, but we care a lot about improving step by step.


✨ Who’s going to thrive with us

You’ll probably feel comfortable here if:

  • You like building products people actually use.

  • You are autonomous and take ownership of what you ship.

  • You take initiative and lead by example.

  • You’re curious and enjoy figuring things out.

  • You’re pragmatic about trade-offs.

  • You communicate with kindness and clarity.

This role is a great fit if you’re excited by the idea of:

  • Building systems that are used by AI agents, not just humans.

  • Designing reliable, safe automation in production.

  • Working on a product that is still early and evolving quickly.

You don’t need to know everything about AI. But you should be curious about it and excited to work in a system where agents are part of the core product 🤖

🧩 What you’ll get from this role

  • Real ownership over parts of the system.

  • Direct impact on customers and product decisions.

  • A small, human team where your work is visible and meaningful 🤝

  • A mix of feature work, system design, and technical improvements.

  • Exposure to real scaling and production challenges.

  • The chance to help build an agent-driven product from the inside.

We offer:

  • Competitive salary and equity.

  • Flexible remote setup (we prefer people to come into Paris or London office twice per week. At a minimum we’d ask you to be at an office 3 days per month, onboard in Paris for your first few weeks, and work CEST timezone).

  • A high-autonomy environment where you have real ownership and space to make an impact.

  • Plenty of room to grow, take responsibility, and shape parts of the product.

  • A culture based on trust, ownership, and clear communication.

This isn’t a huge corporate environment. In exchange, you get autonomy, responsibility, and the chance to shape a product that’s still early in its story—and help build what finance operations will look like in the next decade 🚀

title: Customs AI Integration & Automation Engineer (France)
description:
About Customs Support Group

Customs Support Group (CSG) is the European market leader in customs services, operating across 15 countries. CSG is owned by private equity and a fast-growing, dynamic, data-driven company, dedicated to expanding its presence through strong organic growth and strategic acquisitions. Its key priorities include digital transformation, operational excellence and customer experience, all aimed at driving growth and enhancing efficiency.

The Role

You will take our AI stack and lead its development and customisation for the market.

This is a builder and do-er role. You will design, test and implement practical and compliant agentic AI solutions on top of foundation models document understanding, classification support, retrieval over our own procedures and tariff material, and agents that carry multi-step operational work end to end.

You are not being asked to train models from scratch. You are being asked to make models that already exist behave reliably enough that operations staff trust them with customs declarations, where being wrong has consequences.

Working closely with Operations, Transformation, IT and Group teams, you will turn business needs into scalable solutions.

Key Responsibilities

• Develop and customise AI solutions for the market, from prototype through to production ownership.

• Be curious and prepared to self-learn to use generative-AI to build agents that make a difference to our business

• Identify automation and decision-support opportunities across customs and business processes, and size them honestly before building.

• Design solutions using generative AI and large language models — retrieval, tool calling, structured extraction from customs documentation, and agentic workflows where they genuinely fit.

• Own the evaluation. Define how we know a solution is working before it ships, and how we know a change has not made it worse. This is treated as core to the role, not an afterthought.

• Manage pilots and implementation, and set the criteria for killing a pilot as clearly as the criteria for scaling it.

• Monitor performance, inference cost, latency and business impact.

• Collaborate with local teams, Group functions and technology partners.

• Contribute to privacy, security and AI governance compliance, working with Group Legal and IT Security. You should understand how the EU AI Act applies to what you build, and be able to produce the documentation that goes with it.

.

Requirements

Essential

• 1-2 years AI engineering, software engineering or intelligent automation, including LLM or AI features that real users depended on.

• Strong Python and SQL, with production code ownership. Not familiarity.

• Demonstrable experience integrating large language models into production systems — prompt and context design, retrieval-augmented generation, structured output, and handling failure gracefully.

• Practical experience with at least one major cloud AI platform (Azure AI, AWS Bedrock, or Google Vertex).

• Solid full stack backend engineering fundamentals — APIs, data pipelines, testing, CI/CD. Most of this job is

• Strong communication skills — you will spend real time with operations staff who are experts in customs and not in AI.

• Professional fluency in English.

Desirable

• Evaluation engineering: building eval harnesses and regression suites for non-deterministic systems, LLM-as-judge approaches, and human-in-the-loop review design. This is the single strongest signal we look for and we will weight it heavily.

• Context engineering: designing and version-controlling what a model sees — retrieval strategy, memory, tool descriptions, and policy layers that constrain what an agent is allowed to do.

• Agent orchestration frameworks and standards (LangGraph, MCP, Temporal or equivalent), and experience with long-running or multi-step agent workflows.

• Observability and cost control for inference at volume.

What success looks like in your first year

• By month three: You understand our customs processes well enough to challenge what we ask for, and you have shipped one small, useful thing.

• By month six: At least one AI solution is live, measured against a baseline, and demonstrably better than what it replaced.

• By month twelve: There is a working evaluation process others can use, a ranked pipeline of next opportunities, and at least two colleagues outside IT operating what you have built without you in the room.

What We Offer

• A key role in shaping AI capabilities.

• The opportunity to build solutions with direct business impact, on real operational volume rather than pilots that never leave the lab.

• An international and fast-evolving environment, with peers in other Customs Support Group markets working on the same problems.

• Professional growth opportunities, including a budget for conferences, certification and model/compute costs for your own experiments.

• Permanent role. Hybrid working.

How to apply

Send us your CV and a short note a few paragraphs is plenty describing one system you have put in front of real users. We are most interested in what went wrong with it and what you did about that.

title: Customer Success Associate
description:
Get to Know Us

Horizon3.ai is a fast-growing, remote cybersecurity company dedicated to the mission of enabling organizations to proactively find and fix and verify exploitable attack vectors before criminals exploit them. Our flagship product, the NodeZeroTM platform, delivers production-safe autonomous pentests and other key assessment operations that scale across the largest internal, external, cloud, and hybrid cloud environments. NodeZero has been adopted by organizations of all sizes, from small educational institutions to government agencies and Global 100 enterprises. It is used by ITOps/SecOps teams, consulting pentesters, and MSSPs and MSPs. 

We are a fusion of former U.S. Special Operations cyber operators, startup engineers, and formerly frustrated cybersecurity practitioners. We're committed to helping solve our common security problems: ineffective security tools, false positives resulting in alert fatigue, blind spots, "checkbox” security culture, cybersecurity skills shortage, and the long lead time and expense of hiring outside consultants. Collectively, we are a team of learn it alls, committed to a culture of respect, collaboration, ownership, and results.

 What you will do:

You will serve as a strategic advisor to a portfolio of mid-market customers, partnering directly with technical and business stakeholders to drive adoption, value realization, retention, and growth.

You’ll collaborate cross-functionally with Sales, Product, Engineering, and Support while helping shape and evolve the Customer Success experience across the EMEA region.

  • Deliver technical onboarding and enablement to drive adoption of NodeZero, including advanced features like Tripwires, Insights, and Rapid Response, ensuring customers realize maximum value

  • Act as a customer advocate, relaying customer feedback and technical issues to our internal teams to help drive the evolution of our product and services

  • English fluency required; fluency in French, Spanish, or German preferred

 

Perks of Horizon3.ai

  • Inclusive Team: We value diversity and promote an inclusive culture where everyone can thrive.

  • Growth Opportunities: Be part of a dynamic and growing team with numerous career development opportunities.

  • Innovative Culture: Work in a collaborative environment that encourages creativity and out-of-the-box thinking.

  • Competitive Compensation: We offer competitive salary, equity and benefits. Our benefits include health, vision & dental insurance for you and your family, a flexible vacation policy, and generous parental leave.

Compensation and Values

At Horizon3, we believe that our people are our greatest asset, and our compensation philosophy reflects this core value. We are committed to fostering an environment where all employees feel valued, respected, and rewarded for their contributions. Our compensation structure is designed to be fair, competitive, and transparent, ensuring that every team member is recognized and compensated equitably across roles, levels, and locations.

  • Depending on experience, the compensation range for this position is: €70,000 - €85,000 OTE 80/20 split annually. The exact salary will be determined based on the selected candidate’s location, qualifications, experience, and relevant skills.

  • Additional compensation: All full-time roles are eligible for an equity package in the form of stock options.

We're hiring an Assistant Accountant to own the accounting engine of the finance team: the ledger, the month-end close, and the admin that keeps both clean. Everything else in finance, reporting, forecasting and investor diligence depends on the ledger being right. You’ll build and manage co-sell and marketplace programmes with AWS, Microsoft Azure and Google Cloud, and build joint GTM and delivery motions with Regional and Global Systems Integrators.
