title: 3D Chiplet Engineer
description:
About Us : AI compute is hitting a hard physical wall, and memory bottlenecks are throttling the entire industry. Founded in October 2024 and backed by €57M in funding, Vertical Compute is solving this with proprietary Vertical Integrated Memory (VIM™) chiplets, making AI hardware faster, greener, and vastly more scalable. We are an interdisciplinary team transforming breakthrough semiconductor physics into commercial reality.

Why Now : After 18 months of intensive R&D, Vertical Compute has reached a critical inflection point. Our underlying technology is validated, and we have successfully met our core technical milestones. Armed with a proven technical data package and ongoing system studies, we are now shifting from pure R&D to active engagement with global enterprise customers. As we prepare for our next phase of scale and growth starting in 2027, joining us today means taking direct ownership of the hardware foundation that will power the next era of AI compute.

About the role: 

We are looking for a 3D Integration / Chiplet Expert to define and implement 2.5D/3D advanced packaging solutions for our Vertical Integrated Memory (VIM) technology. You will collaborate across teams to define optimal interconnect strategies and die stacking approaches to enable high-bandwidth, low-power operation. This job sits at the intersection of SoC architecture (specifically the physical design) , package design, and 3D manufacturing processes. 

Key Responsibilities:

  • Integration Architecture & Process Definition:
    Develop and define architectures for 2.5D/3D stacking of VIM chiplets with compute chiplets.
    Collaborate with design and technology teams to develop interconnect solutions that ensure high bandwidth and low latency.
    Define clearly the impact of the chiplet physical design chiplets (through-silicon vias, micro-bumps, hybrid bonds, redistribution layers, and chiplet interfaces, …)
    define fabrication flows and design rules with foundries, packaging partners, and internal physical design teams

  • Performance Analysis & Simulation:
    Conduct early multi-physics simulations (thermal, electrical, mechanical) to analyze and optimize the performance and reliability of integrated systems.
    drive external partners for final package design

  • Collaboration & Communication:
    Partner closely with design, process engineering, metrology, and system architecture teams.
    Participate in conferences, standardization bodies and industry events to promote or lead discussions about the future of chiplet integration.

  • Technical Leadership:Provide
    technical leadership and project management guidance to multidisciplinary  teams.

About the team: 

This role is part of the Product & system team, partnering closely with our cross-functional engineering teams in Product & system  and Memory Design. We foster a highly collaborative, inclusive environment where strong alignment, high transparency and seamless team coordination are central to our shared success.



About who you are:

  • You’ve spent 5–10 years exploring the frontiers of 2.5D/3D packaging and heterogeneous integration, turning complex ideas into manufacturable systems.

  • You have a deep understanding on the SoC physical design, TSVs, Redistribution Layers, hybrid bonding and how they are used at system level to implement chip IOs (Functional and power IOs)   

  • You are mastering Integrity 3D-IC Platform to define the chiplets interface, to define 3D stacking system, to generate the 3Dblox views, and to run all the 3D system level analysis (Power Delivery Network, Thermal, STA, LVS, SI/PI, …)    

  • You thrive where architecture meets technology — translating ambitious concepts into elegant, high-performance designs.

  • Multi-physics isn’t just theory to you; you use thermal, electrical, and mechanical simulations to see the whole system clearly.

  • You’re naturally collaborative — just as comfortable in technical deep dives as you are building bridges between design, process, and system teams.

  • You’re the kind of engineer who balances vision with execution: leading projects, mentoring peers, and pushing boundaries with a calm hand.

  • Above all, you’re curious — drawn to the challenge of building something new and meaningful at the intersection of memory, compute, and packaging innovation.

  • Fluency in English with strong written and verbal communication abilities.


Why Join Us:

  • You will get the opportunity to work at the forefront of memory technology innovation.

  • Vertical Compute is not only a state-of-the art but also a human adventure. We believe you must have a lot of fun developing the best of you. Making sure you and your team are going to enjoy the journey and become passionate about what we do is a key goal of our founders.

  • You can be part of a talented and dedicated team in a fast-paced startup environment.

  • In this role, you contribute to projects that will have a significant impact on the future of computing and electronics.

  • You can count on a motivating total rewards package.

  • Flexible ways of working.

Join us in shaping the future of compute & memory technology — and celebrating success!

title: Software Engineer - Map & Route
description:
Before the detail, here's the challenge you'd help us solve.

We build the embodied intelligence that moves real vehicles safely, and the ecosystem a billion machines will run on in the future. Very few people in AI can say this. Every role here, whatever the team, plugs into that.

Here’s what this particular role covers.

 

🛠️ About our Map & Route Team

Our Map & Route team sits within Wayve’s Automotive Platforms division in Vehicle Software Engineering, and builds the geospatial foundations behind our AI driver. Working with global-scale data, the team turns road-network and navigation data into reliable products used across Wayve, building geospatial services and data products to support company operations. We work with our model development, experimentation, and evaluation platforms to build an AI driver that uses maps and navigation data like an expert human driver by using map information to enhance training and evaluation of performance. We are a full-stack team owning mapping end to end, getting to touch work that is infrastructure, data engineering, data science, backend and frontend.

 

🧠 Your day-to-day

  • Write full-stack services in Python and Typescript, creating novel geospatial services to solve challenging and unique problems we face in building our AI driving products.

  • Collaborate with internal teams to understand requirements and build solutions with global geospatial data.

  • Design and build data pipelines with PySpark and Databricks to enrich fleet data with mapping and road-network information at global scale.

  • Build applications and datasets that support route planning and the preparation of map data for training and simulation.

  • Integrate with navigation and mapping APIs from providers such as Mapbox, TomTom and Google Maps.

  • Maintain, support and improve the services the team already runs.

  • Deploy and operate your services on Azure and Kubernetes, owning them end to end.

 

🧩 What you’ll be working on

  • Global-scale geospatial enrichment pipelines that tell us where we’ve driven and what the road network looks like.

  • Route-planning applications and datasets that help our teams decide where to drive next.

  • Map data preparation for model training and simulation.

  • New services you’ll take from idea to production and lead end to end.

 

🙌 You should apply if

  • You are a strong, hands-on Python engineer who can deliver high-quality production code at pace.

  • You are comfortable with an AI-assisted or AI engineering workflow (ideation, planning, implementation and review).

  • You have built and operated large-scale data pipelines using Spark or PySpark.

  • You are comfortable writing SQL to query and analyse large datasets.

  • You have working knowledge of cloud infrastructure and container orchestration, ideally Azure and Kubernetes, and are happy to own deployment, monitoring, and observability of your services.

  • You enjoy taking ownership of new services and seeing them through end to end.

  • Experience with geospatial data processing, road-network data or routing engines (e.g. OpenStreetMap, TomTom, HERE or Overture data, PostGIS, navigation APIs) would be a strong advantage.

  • Experience with Bazel or monorepo build systems is desirable but not mandatory.

  • Experience with workflow orchestration tools such as Flyte or Airflow would be a bonus.

 

🌱 Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! If you’re passionate about autonomy and keen to learn, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every requirement.

 

More about Wayve:

🚀 Wayve is building the leading AI platform for autonomous driving. We are pioneering an end to end AI approach that enables vehicles to learn directly from real world experience, developing the ability to adapt, generalise and improve at scale. Instead of relying on hand coded rules or pre mapped environments, our AI Driver learns to drive by understanding the world around it. The result is technology that navigates complex urban environments with intelligence, precision and natural flow, unlocking meaningful advances in both safety and efficiency. We believe autonomy represents a once in a generation transformation in how people and goods move, comparable to the shift from horses to cars, and from human driven vehicles to intelligent machines.

Our ambition is to make autonomy universal. Wayve’s mapless and hardware agnostic AI platform integrates with global OEM partners, enabling continuous software evolution and unlocking advanced levels of automation from L2 plus through to L4 as our core AI model scales. In a race increasingly defined by intelligence and real world learning, Wayve is taking a distinct approach, building a generalisable driving intelligence that can power any vehicle, anywhere. By combining embodied AI with scalable deployment, we are creating technology that can be shaped to each OEM brand and driver experience, accelerating the transition to a safer, more intelligent future of mobility.

 

How we work 💻- Locations & Flexible Working:

Our main hubs are in London, Sunnyvale, Yokohama, Herzliya, Vancouver and Leonberg. We operate a hybrid working model that combines in-person collaboration in our dedicated office spaces with focused time working remotely. This gives our teams the connection and energy of working together, alongside the flexibility to do their best work in a way that fits their lives.

 

🔍 The Interview Process:

Our process is clear and respectful of your time:

  • Initial call / recruiter screen (30 mins)

  • Competency interviews: Python Programming (60 mins) and Hiring Manager interview (45 mins)

  • Deep-dive technical interviews: Systems Design (60 mins) and Domain interview (60 mins)

title: (Senior) Integration Engineer, ERP (Oracle)
description:
Join BLP and help make the world’s business processes autonomous!

Our agentic platform helps finance and operations teams worldwide remove manual work from their core business processes, so work runs end-to-end with greater control and significant productivity gains.

Today, over 550 enterprise customers use BLP across 1,300+ deployed projects. In the processes we automate, customers achieve productivity improvements of 5 to 10 times.

To date, BLP remains majority employee-owned, with Goldman Sachs holding a minority stake as a growth investor. Our success is driven by deep expertise in technology and business processes, a superior product with strong product-market fit, reflected in an expanding customer base that includes Fortune 500 companies.

BLP is one of Switzerland's fastest-growing SaaS scale-ups; we are now entering our next phase of growth. From our headquarters on Zürich's Bahnhofstrasse, we're expanding globally, with a growing presence across Europe and North America.

Join us and help make autonomous operations the new standard.

About the role

BLP only works when it talks to our customers’ ERP systems. As an Integration Engineer, you build and own those connections and keep live integrations running for enterprise customers. Every new ERP system is a new problem to solve. You’ll lead our Oracle integrations across Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP, NetSuite and JD Edwards, while also contributing to other integrations.

 

What you’ll do

  • Own our integrations with Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP, NetSuite and JD Edwards and ensure their market fit, usability and reliability.

  • Design and implement interfaces for diverse protocols: REST, SOAP, direct DB access and file transfers.

  • Explore new ERP systems and determine the best way to connect them.

  • Build new ERP integrations, often in close collaboration with pilot customers.

  • Own existing integrations end to end, including issue resolution, and document them so teammates can pick them up.

  • Enable technical project managers to consult on, install and configure mature integrations.

 

What you'll bring

  • Hands-on integration experience with Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP, NetSuite or JD Edwards EnterpriseOne, ideally more than one. You have built or maintained interfaces yourself, not only used the system as a functional consultant or key user.

  • Experience with the native interfaces of at least one of these:

    • Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP: REST and SOAP web services, File-Based Data Import (FBDI) through the ERP Integration Service, and data extraction with BI Publisher or BI Cloud Connector (BICC).

    • NetSuite: SuiteTalk REST and SOAP web services, SuiteQL, SuiteScript 2.x (e.g., RESTlets, Map/Reduce scripts), and Token-Based Authentication or OAuth 2.0.

    • JD Edwards EnterpriseOne: AIS Server and Orchestrator, Business Services (BSSV), and Z-file interface tables (e.g., F0411Z1) with their batch processors.

  • A good understanding of purchase-to-pay data in Oracle ERPs: suppliers, purchase orders, receipts and supplier invoice matching.

  • Solid programming skills in at least one backend language. We build our integrations in Go. If you come from Java, C#, Python or similar and are keen to pick up Go, that works for us.

  • A degree in computer science or a related field, or equivalent experience.

  • A structured, self-reliant way of working, and ideally experience in a client-facing role.

  • Fluent English. German is a plus, as most of our customers are in the DACH region.

Nice to have:

  • Experience with both cloud (Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP, NetSuite) and on-premise (JD Edwards) environments, and the constraints of each (e.g., no direct database access in Fusion, governance limits in NetSuite).

  • Extensive experience with SQL, common data formats (JSON, XML, CSV) and transports (REST/SOAP APIs, SFTP).

  • Familiarity with modern engineering practices: Git, code reviews, automated testing and CI/CD.

  • Integration experience with other ERPs, such as SAP, Microsoft Dynamics or Infor.

 

Integration Engineer or Senior Integration Engineer

We hire at both levels. Four things decide where you start: years of experience, breadth of experience, coaching experience and scope.

Integration Engineer

  • Years: 2+ years of hands-on integration work, including Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP, NetSuite or JD Edwards.

  • Breadth: in-depth experience with one Oracle ERP and its interfaces.

  • Coaching: you learn quickly from senior colleagues and share what you learn with the team.

  • Scope: you deliver and maintain integrations and resolve issues independently, with guidance on architecture decisions.

Senior Integration Engineer

  • Years: 5+ years of hands-on integration work, several of them with Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP, NetSuite or JD Edwards.

  • Breadth: integration experience across two or more of Fusion, NetSuite and JD Edwards, or across Oracle and other ERPs, in cloud and on-premise environments.

  • Coaching: you have coached or mentored other engineers and help technical project managers grow.

  • Scope: you own our Oracle integrations end to end, set technical direction and take on the most complex customer cases.

Why BLP

  • Real impact: your integrations decide whether a customer goes live.

  • Breadth: Oracle, Infor, Microsoft Dynamics and many other ERPs, plus EDI and e-invoicing standards.

  • Growth: fast-tracked growth, with promotions and a bonus scheme that includes company shares.

  • Team: regular team events.

Practical information

  • Location: our Zurich office, hybrid with 3+ office days per week, or remotely from anywhere in Europe.

  • If you work remotely, we pay for regular visits and stays in Zurich.

  • Employment: full-time, permanent.

 

Learn more about blp and our values at blp.digital/company/careers.

title: People Operations Partner
description:
📈 Who We Are:

We are rebuilding the energy transaction, making it transparent and fair.

Our goal is to put power back where it belongs, in the hands of customers and to take on one of the most critical problems of our century, access to low cost electricity.

tem exists to fix a broken global energy market that’s long favoured legacy operators, intermediaries, and opaque pricing. Today’s electricity system was not designed for rapid decarbonisation, AI-driven efficiency or fair access for the actual users - businesses and generators.

We’ve built the first AI native transaction infrastructure to reinvent how electricity is bought, sold and priced. Our technology is designed to cut out the inefficient fees, automate complex market flows, and bring transparency and fairness to energy transactions at scale.

In late 2025, after extraordinary growth, we closed a $75 million Series B - led by Lightspeed Venture Partners with participation from Albion, Atomico, Allianz, Hitachi Ventures, Hitachi Ventures, Schroders Capital and others - positioning us for global expansion, deeper product innovation and category leadership.

We’re scaling internationally and building toward a future where AI-driven infrastructure is foundational to electricity markets worldwide.

Since launch, our modern utility product, known as RED, has already facilitated thousands of business customers and billions in energy transaction value, proving that modern software and AI can transform an industry built on legacy systems.

At tem, we’re not just building another energy company, we’re rearchitecting market infrastructure so that transparency, efficiency and sustainability become the default, not the exception.

🚀 The Role

We're hiring a People Operations Partner to join our Performance team.

tem is rebuilding the energy transaction - transparent, fair and built on trust. Behind that mission is a company growing fast, and a Performance team that's already lean and stretched. Core People operations needs more firepower as we scale, and there's a direct commercial angle too: a strong People Operations function is what lets new joiners ramp up and become productive faster once they arrive.

This is a multi-disciplinary People Operations role at the centre of the employee lifecycle - equal parts operational delivery, automation and continuous improvement. You'll be the reliable hands keeping People processes running as we scale, from multi-country payroll to onboarding, employee changes and offboarding. You'll also build the tools, automations and lightweight AI workflows that connect our systems (Rippling, Notion, Linear, Slack, Ashby, n8n and Google Workspace), so the function doesn't need to double in size every time headcount does.

In your first 12 months, you might:

  • Take ownership of payroll across our UK and employer-of-record employees, keeping every cycle accurate and on time as pay schedules and countries multiply.

  • Become the trusted point of contact for employees and managers, owning their queries through to resolution.

  • Build the automations and AI-enabled workflows that remove repetitive manual work from the employee lifecycle.

  • Turn recurring pain points into better processes, tools or self-service, and measure whether they actually worked.

  • Move across People disciplines as priorities shift - reward and benchmarking, pensions and options administration, performance cycles, engagement and people data.

🛠️ Responsibilities

  • Run payroll end to end: own monthly payroll across UK and employer-of-record employees - changes, corrections, off-cycle and ex-gratia payments, contractor payroll and invoicing, and country-specific items - keeping it accurate and on time as we add pay schedules and countries.

  • Keep the lifecycle running: deliver core People operations across onboarding, employee changes, contracts and documentation, leave, mobility (visas and international moves), EOR and contractor setup, and offboarding, flexing into whatever the business needs most.

  • Be the trusted point of contact: own employee and manager queries through to resolution with a clear response standard, rather than passing them between functions.

  • Keep the foundations accurate: maintain employee data, documentation and systems so that everything else can depend on them.

  • Automate the repeatable: build and maintain automations and lightweight AI-enabled tools, workflows and agents that connect Rippling, Notion, Linear, Slack, Ashby, n8n, Google Workspace and similar, and remove repetitive manual work - with controls so speed never costs accuracy, privacy or employee trust.

  • Own the People tech stack: evolve our People technology ecosystem - evaluate emerging tools, consolidate where we can, and simplify the architecture.

  • Improve continuously: turn recurring employee and manager pain points into better processes, tools, guidance or self-service, measure whether they worked, and give foundational People processes a named owner and a runbook someone else could follow cold.

  • Design to delight and to scale: we treat our people like top athletes and aim to delight at every step of the employee journey, and what works at today's size shouldn't need twice the People team when headcount doubles - default to eliminating or automating work rather than administering it.

  • Partner across the business: work with Finance, Legal, Talent, Performance Partners and functional specialists to turn People initiatives into scalable services, and build dashboards and lightweight analysis that help the team and the business make better decisions.

✅ Requirements

Must-Haves

  • You've worked in People Operations, People Services, HR Operations or another operational People role - generalists welcome - and you hold a high bar on accuracy and confidentiality.

  • You've run payroll cycles end to end, ideally multi-country, in-house or through an employer of record. UK fundamentals (PAYE, RTI, pension auto-enrolment, statutory payments) are familiar, or clearly learnable fast if your payroll experience comes from another market.

  • You're highly comfortable with technology: AI is part of how you work, you actively experiment with new tools and capabilities, and you can build automations through no-code or low-code tools, integrations and AI workflows.

  • You think in systems and workflows rather than individual tasks, with a strong instinct for simplification ("why are we doing this manually?"), and you're comfortable using data to diagnose problems and make decisions.

  • You operate effectively in ambiguity, without waiting for a perfectly defined process or remit, and you balance efficiency with empathy - People Operations is about people, not just workflows.

  • Strong ownership instincts: when something's broken, unclear or inefficient, your instinct is to fix it, and you're willing to move across People disciplines depending on where the organisation needs you.

Desirable

  • Breadth across the People remit beyond Operations - reward and benchmarking, pensions, benefits, or performance and engagement. This role is deliberately multi-disciplinary.

  • Familiarity with the basics of UK and EU employment law, and experience administering equity or share options (for example EMI or unapproved schemes, and cap-table tools such as Vestd).

  • Experience supporting international employment through employers of record, and setting up or managing contractors (including off-payroll and IR35 awareness).

  • Experience in a fast-scaling startup or scale-up, especially through a period of doubling headcount or entering new countries.

🎁 Benefits & Perks

  • Stock options so everyone has ownership in our mission.

  • 25 days holiday plus public holidays. Swap public holidays for the ones that matter most to you, and enjoy your birthday off.

  • Remote first and flexible working, with clear core hours and no internal meetings on Friday afternoons.

  • Up to GBP1,200 or EUR1,400 per year for your remote setup.

  • Up to GBP150 or EUR170 per month for wellbeing.

🤝 Interview Process

We move fast. Most processes take 2 to 3 weeks from first chat to offer. If you need us to adapt anything, let us know.

  • Intro call with our Talent team.

  • Hiring Manager interview.

  • Skills interview, which might include a practical exercise.

  • Bar Raiser interview with leadership stakeholders.

We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, experiences, and identities, including those that are traditionally underrepresented in the tech and energy sectors. If you’re excited about this role but not sure you meet every requirement, we’d still love to hear from you. Your unique perspective could be exactly what we’re looking for.

Deine Herausforderungen

  • We believe that technology only makes sense when it truly helps people

description:
Adaptyv is building an automated lab that lets AI agents run biology experiments.

We're entering the era of agentic science where AI models can now design novel proteins, propose hypotheses, and iterate on experimental results. But they can't run the experiments themselves - that's still a manual, months-long process. We're building the infrastructure that gives AI agents access to the physical world.

We are one of the fastest growing biotech companies, trusted by leading biopharmas, frontier AI labs, and the techbio companies pushing the field forward. This is a rare chance to help advance some of the most important work happening in biotech today.

Our automated lab is powered by a deep software + hardware stack: lab instruments worth millions of USD reverse-engineered into API-controllable hardware, dozens of devices orchestrated through complex workflows, full observability on everything that happens in the lab, processing pipelines for messy physical-world data, and AI systems that troubleshoot production results and accelerate assay development.

We’re growing rapidly and are hiring for talented people to scale and support the massive demand for AI-driven wet lab experimentation.

About the Role

You'll be a player-coach — someone who still ships code but also owns the engineering roadmap, team structure, and technical direction. You'll translate company strategy into engineering priorities, make sure the right things get built in the right order, and help a small, high-output team scale without losing speed.

You'll lead a small, technical engineering team that leverages AI to build the software infrastructure for running our automated lab. Your job is to make it the best small engineering team in biotech, and grow it thoughtfully as we scale.

This is not a management-track role where you stop building. You'll stay hands-on, especially as AI agents reshape what a small engineering team can accomplish. We expect you to be deeply technical, opinionated about architecture, and actively shipping — while also being the person who ensures the whole engineering org is pointed in the right direction and moving fast.

Day-to-day, that can mean:

  • Owning the engineering roadmap — deciding what to build, what to defer, and what to kill

  • Setting technical direction and architecture across frontend, backend, data pipelines, and lab-hardware integration

  • Shipping code yourself on the highest-leverage problems, not just reviewing it

  • Hiring, growing, and setting the bar for a team that ships fast and holds quality high — our lab runs on this software, so when things break, real experiments fail and real customers are affected

  • Building the team's AI-assisted development practices into a genuine speed advantage

What we're looking for

  • Still building. You've shipped production software for years and you're not looking to leave the code behind — you want a role where you build and lead at the same time.

  • You've built teams. You've hired, managed, and developed engineers, and built a team that ships fast and holds a high bar — at least once before, in a startup or high-growth environment.

  • Roadmap ownership. You've owned or significantly shaped an engineering roadmap. You've made the call on what to build, defer, and kill — and you make pragmatic tradeoffs that keep things shipping and stop projects from growing out of scope.

  • Technical breadth. You make good architectural decisions across frontend, backend, data, and infrastructure, and you know when to go deep versus when to delegate.

  • AI-native. It's 2026 — you already build with AI agents and coding tools as a force multiplier, and you have a real point of view on how they change team structure, tooling, and workflow.

  • A genuine interest in biology. No background required, but our product is running biology experiments in the physical world and that should excite you.

  • High-autonomy, founder mindset. We share context and vision openly. You figure out what matters most and go work on it.

title: Community Manager
description:
Adaptyv is building an automated lab that lets AI agents run biology experiments.

We're entering the era of agentic science where AI models can now design novel proteins, propose hypotheses, and iterate on experimental results. But they can't run the experiments themselves - that's still a manual, months-long process. We're building the infrastructure that gives AI agents access to the physical world.

We are one of the fastest growing biotech companies, trusted by leading biopharmas, frontier AI labs, and the techbio companies pushing the field forward. This is a rare chance to help advance some of the most important work happening in biotech today.

Our automated lab is powered by a deep software + hardware stack: lab instruments worth millions of USD reverse-engineered into API-controllable hardware, dozens of devices orchestrated through complex workflows, full observability on everything that happens in the lab, processing pipelines for messy physical-world data, and AI systems that troubleshoot production results and accelerate assay development.

We’re growing rapidly and are hiring for talented people to scale and support the massive demand for AI-driven wet lab experimentation.

About the role

You'll be the person who makes sure Adaptyv shows up well in public, every day. That means managing our social presence across X and LinkedIn, running the Proteinbase community, owning the participant side of our open competitions and hackathons, and triaging inbound community and customer messages. Whatever it takes to keep our community-facing surface area healthy as we grow.

This is a hands-on, high-ownership role. You'll be the go-to person for anything community: content, social, events, and the day-to-day rhythm of how Adaptyv talks to the outside world. You'll work closely with the founders and the science team, and you'll have a direct impact on how the protein design and AI bio communities experience us.

 

Responsibilities

  • Manage Adaptyv's day-to-day social presence on X and LinkedIn: product updates, customer wins, blog amplifications, conference content, and reactive posts on what's happening in the field.

  • Run the Proteinbase community day-to-day: newsletter, competition updates, designer spotlights, and the Slack where participants and contributors gather.

  • Own the participant-facing side of our open competitions and hackathons, from applicant communication and rules through to judging logistics and post-event recaps. Turn each event into a public artifact (leaderboard, dataset, blog post).

  • Triage inbound community and customer messages, routing deeper technical questions to the right person on the team.

  • Coordinate with the founders and the science team on what to post, what to amplify, and what to hold.

 

What we're looking for

  • 1-3 years running social, content, or community for a technical company, a science-adjacent media brand, an event series, or a community platform. Self-built audiences and adjacent experience count equally.

  • A strong, distinctive writing voice. You move between LinkedIn announcements, customer replies, and community posts without defaulting to generic AI phrasing.

  • Genuine curiosity about biology and AI. No science degree required, but you should be able to follow technical conversations in protein design and AI without needing them explained.

  • Highly organized. You'll juggle multiple channels, partnerships, and ongoing threads simultaneously, and build the systems to track them.

  • Comfortable with ambiguity. There is no editorial calendar or playbook. You'll decide what's worth posting based on what we're shipping and what the field is discussing.

  • Bonus: existing presence in protein design or AI bio circles, prior experience running a hackathon or competition, short-form video editing, or a track record of building a technical community from scratch.

 

Location: On-site or remote, with timezone overlap with US or Europe. Occasional travel to Lausanne and to events.

Application deadline

We are reviewing applicants on a rolling basis.

title: Head of Platform (Infrastructure & DevOps)
description:
What we are building

Mimica is an AI-powered process intelligence platform enabling enterprises and individuals to reclaim their most precious resource: time. We've all seen repetitive tasks and redundant processes quietly drain productivity and creativity. Not because companies don’t want to become more efficient, but because they don’t know where to start.

Mimica automatically analyzes your team’s work, then generates the AI agents to execute it. Our software turns everyday work into data-backed decisions, helping companies remove process bottlenecks, automate the right tasks, and upskill teams with precision and confidence.

We’ve raised $26 million in Series B financing and are scaling fast. Backed by investors including Khosla Ventures and Paladin Capital, our proprietary AI technology is trusted by Fortune 500 companies to accelerate transformation. Mimica is recognized as a Top 100 AI Start-up by Accel and an industry Leader by the Everest Group.

Our team

Behind our platform is a team of exceptionally talented people, remote-first and globally distributed across 16+ countries. We're looking for curious, collaborative people excited to solve complex problems. You'll join a fast-paced environment built on high ownership, bottom-up thinking, and transparent, open communication – helping some of the world's leading organizations transform the way work gets done with AI.

Your mission

Mimica is growing fast, and so is the demand on our Platform Team. As Head of Platform, you will lead a lean but highly capable team that is the backbone of every engineering squad in the company, and you will own the infrastructure strategy, including all AI infrastructure, as we scale.

The Platform team services the entire engineering organisation: keeping environments healthy, unblocking teams, building the infrastructure that lets everyone else move faster, and working with teams regarding SRE topics and developer experience too. As you work with us, the role will develop into designing Mimica’s infrastructure strategy at scale. The team has 4 engineers today, around 6 by the end of the year, and 10+ in 2027, so the role has the potential to grow into a “manager of managers” level as the company grows.

This is a role with real scope: expanding to multi-region and physically separated database environments, supporting Mimica’s first installable infrastructure component for enterprise, and owning FinOps. One day you are defining the standard menu of deployment options for enterprise customers, the next you are in a security review or an architecture decision on AI infrastructure.

We are looking for leaders with either an application development or a systems/infrastructure background.

What matters more than your origin story is your hands-on credibility with Kubernetes, IaC, and cloud platforms, your ability to lead engineers and other leaders, and your ability to collaborate closely with Product, ML, Security, Sales and Customer Success. If you want to work in a place where your contributions are visible, your scope is broad, and the problems are real, this is the role for you.

Part of your day-to-day

  • Own Mimica's infrastructure strategy and the platform roadmap across all products, with the final call on cloud architecture, deployment models, infra vendors and platform standards.

  • Lead and grow the Platform team: Manage existing Platform and SREs, plan headcount, set goals and metrics, and design the sub-team split (Cloud & Developer Platform, Reliability & SRE, AI Infrastructure) as the team grows.

  • Own all AI infrastructure, including training and serving infra, MLOps tooling, Vertex and model access.

  • Maintain Mimica’s DevEx culture - improve agency for product teams without compromising on compliance, create paved roads for deployments, and identify pain points as they arise.

  • Own the infra and LLM budget, forecast and unit economics, including cost attribution by product and customer and the GCP relationship.

  • Own reliability across engineering: SLOs, on-call model, incident process, postmortems, DR testing and capacity planning.

  • Own the CI/CD and developer platform, infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, ArgoCD, Crossplane) and observability standards (Honeycomb, Grafana, Loki).

  • Work with the Platform PM, your peer, to define client needs and turn them into the platform roadmap.

  • Act as the named technical owner for infrastructure in enterprise deals and security reviews, joining high-stakes sales and client calls and coaching your team to take the rest.

  • Guide the craft mentors for infrastructure, MLOps and Python engineering, and set engineering-wide standards for reliability, on-call, CI/CD and craft.

  • Report monthly platform health and costs to leadership, and lead the infrastructure part of technical due diligence.

Requirements

  • Proven experience leading engineers, ideally including managing a team lead or other managers, and growing a team through hiring and sub-team design.

  • Solid hands-on experience with Kubernetes, whether on GKE (preferred), EKS, OnPrem, or another managed Kubernetes service, across multiple regions.

  • Proven experience with infrastructure-as-code as a core part of your platform, such as Terraform, and with ArgoCD or a comparable GitOps tool.

  • A track record in owning reliability: setting SLOs and SLAs, running on-call, leading incident response and postmortems, and testing disaster recovery.

  • Observability experience with at least one major platform: Honeycomb, Datadog, Grafana, or New Relic.

  • Comfortable with code, and able to review architecture and prototypes hands-on.

  • Experience owning an infrastructure budget, including cloud cost attribution, forecasting and cloud-provider relationships.

  • Experience designing deployment models for enterprise customers (single tenant, regional, data residency) and supporting security reviews and contracted SLAs.

  • Background in startups or scale-ups: you are used to ambiguity, moving fast, and wearing multiple hats.

  • Strong communication and collaboration skills: you can translate infrastructure complexity into clear language for engineers, executives and clients, and you know when to say no to bespoke requests.

Bonus / Nice to have

  • Familiarity with Crossplane, or a similar product like Config Connector.

  • Experience with Temporal for workflow orchestration.

  • Security and compliance experience, particularly supporting SOC 2.

  • Experience supporting a funding round, including technical due diligence.

What we offer

💰 Generous compensation + stock options - aligned with our internal framework, market data, and individual skills.

🏢 Distributed work: Work from anywhere - fully remote, in our hubs, or a mix.

💻 Company-issued laptop, remote setup stipend, and co-working budget

📍 Flexible schedules and location

☀️ Ample paid time off, in addition to local public holidays

🍼 Enhanced parental leave

🧘‍♀️ Health & retirement benefits

📖 Annual learning & development budget

🌴 Annual workaways and regular virtual & in-person socials

🌍 Opportunity to contribute to groundbreaking projects that shape the future of work

title: Founding Enterprise Account Executive, DACH
description:
Our Mission:

Omnea is the agentic operating system for procurement.

Procurement touches every pound a business spends, yet requests still stall for weeks and approvals get lost in inboxes. Our AI-first platform changes that: our agents capture requests, route approvals, onboard suppliers, flag risk and track every renewal, while anyone in the business can ask a question and get an answer grounded in their own company’s data. Buying becomes painless for everyone, procurement gets a seat at the table, and our customers have saved more than 100,000 hours of manual work so far.

Companies like Spotify, PayPal, T. Rowe Price, JustEat, Adyen and S&P Global run procurement on Omnea. We’re backed by $75M from Khosla Ventures, Insight Partners and Accel, and we’ve been named the UK’s number one startup in the Startups 100, ranked 11th on Sifted’s 2026 list of Europe’s fastest-growing companies, and recognised as one of Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies.

Talent density matters more to us than almost anything else. We keep the bar high in every team, so everyone here has real ownership and real impact. Our team is full of former founders and operators who’ve scaled unicorns, and we’re looking for people who want to do the best work of their careers alongside them.

Find out more about the team and life at Omnea here.

The role in one line

Be Omnea's first Enterprise Account Executive in DACH, as one of Europe's fastest-growing AI companies expands globally.

Why now

Omnea is the UK's number one startup for 2026 and the 11th fastest-growing tech company in Europe. We're in the middle of a major global expansion and hiring Enterprise Account Executives to lead it in each region. The product, customers and sales motion are proven. What's missing is the person who takes them into DACH.

  • We win 86% of live RFPs against our biggest competitor

  • More than 3x ARR growth in the last 12 months, with 40% in Q3 alone

  • Under 20% of enterprises use modern procurement software today. Gartner expects that to reach 50% by 2027

  • Global enterprises including Spotify, Wise, Adecco and McAfee already run on Omnea

What you'll do

  • Open DACH from Frankfurt or Munich: build pipeline, run complex enterprise cycles and close our first wave of local customers

  • Run multi-stakeholder new business deals across Finance, Procurement, Legal, Security and IT, from first meeting to signature

  • Shape how Omnea goes to market in DACH: messaging, target verticals, partners and events

  • Take what you hear from buyers straight to product and engineering, and see it shipped

  • Lay the foundations for the team that follows you

Who this is for

  • 3 to 7 years in B2B SaaS sales, with a record of closing enterprise new business in DACH

  • Fluent German and English

  • Consistently at or near the top of the leaderboard

  • Comfortable building pipeline from zero, before there's a local team around you

  • At home in long, complex cycles and the stakeholders that come with them

title: Senior Accountant – Finance Operations (m/f/d)
description:
About us

EggAI is a fast-growing, 100% remote AI consulting and development startup based in Munich. We build agentic AI solutions for enterprise clients. We are growing in several European markets at the same time, are actively building our internal structures — and are looking for someone to help shape this growth phase.

Your role

You are our go-to person for day-to-day accounting. You make sure every receipt, invoice and expense ends up in the right place — cost center, account, country — and you prepare everything so that our external tax advisor can book without back-and-forth. You work across several European countries, with employees and freelancers, and with local payroll providers. We don’t have fully established processes yet, so you won’t just follow a playbook: you spot gaps, think the process through and set it up yourself. You work closely with our Head of Finance, who owns controlling, forecasting and reporting, and with our external tax advisor, who handles ongoing bookkeeping, annual financial statements and German payroll. You ideally bring your own experience from a tax advisory firm or a similar environment.

Your responsibilities

 

● Preparatory bookkeeping: Pre-code receipts and prepare them for ongoing bookkeeping by our tax advisor

● Receipt and invoice management: Collect receipts and incoming invoices, review them, and consistently follow up on open items

● Correct allocation: Make sure expenses are assigned to the correct cost center and the correct account in the chart of accounts

● Travel expenses across Europe: Manage per diems (meal allowances), mileage allowances and comparable expense rules across countries for our teams in Europe

● Employees & freelancers across Europe: Know the Europe-wide controlling and accounting topics that apply to employees and freelancers — or get up to speed on them quickly

● International payroll interface: Manage local payroll providers and salary payments

● Cash flow: Think along on cash flow structures & reporting, and keep them up to date

● Process setup: Independently think through and set up finance processes and structures in an international, growing environment

What you bring

Must have

● 4+ years of professional experience in finance & accounting

● German at a fluent professional level (C1/C2), including German accounting and tax terminology; English at least B1, as our team is diverse and English is often the working language

● Very good DATEV skills and solid understanding of the chart of accounts and correct account assignment

● Flexibility with tools: you quickly find your way around other systems such as Odoo

● You have owned finance and accounting topics end-to-end, without day-to-day guidance

● You are comfortable in gray areas and make good decisions even without complete information

Nice to have

● Completed commercial vocational training or a degree with a focus on finance, accounting or controlling

● Understanding of how a balance sheet should be structured to be meaningful for investors — ideally through your own experience in a tax advisory firm or similar environment

● Exposure to controlling topics such as cost centers, forecasts or project margins

● Motivated, proactive and creative personality with a hands-on mentality — you want to shape things, not just administer them

Why EggAI?

● 100% remote work in an international, highly motivated team

● Flat structures and direct access to the Head of Finance and the founders — short paths, fast decisions

● Freedom to shape: you help build the finance infrastructure of an AI scale-up from the ground up

● Insight into one of the most dynamic growth fields in tech and into building a company across Europe

Sounds like you?

We'd love to hear from you!

If your profile looks like a good match we'll be in touch to organise a first stage interview.

Please note, due to the high volume of candidates, we cannot offer personalized feedback to each candidate.

title: Senior Analytics Engineer - EMEA
description:
Seeq builds advanced analytics software that unlocks insights from industrial process data—empowering companies in sectors like pharmaceuticals, oil & gas, chemicals, and power generation to optimize operations and drive business value.

As a remote-first company since our founding, we’re built for collaboration across time zones. Our engineering and customer-facing teams thrive in a supportive, agile environment that emphasizes curiosity, learning, and continuous improvement.

Analytics Engineers at Seeq serve as trusted technical advisors to our customers, helping them solve complex process challenges and maximize value from our software. You’ll work directly with end users to design scalable, high-impact analytics solutions that drive engagement, adoption, and tangible business outcomes.

 

Key Duties & Responsibilities:

As a key customer-facing team member, you will participate in the following activities:

 Customer Technical Adoption 

  • Serve as the customer’s trusted technical advisor by building relationships with champions and end-users through solution design, implementation guidance, and technical mentorship.
  • Leverage customer relationships to perform constant discovery and uncover high-value, high-impact use case opportunities directly linked to the customer’s critical business workflows and objectives.
  • Collaborate with the customer and account team to develop and execute strategic plans for adoption of Seeq and completion of key use cases addressing business objectives.
  • Advise customer champions and end-users to implement and operationalize the use cases to deliver a high return on investment for the customer. Occasionally may require hands-on delivery to accelerate a customer’s high value use case.
  • Upskill Seeq’s partner ecosystem to be an extension of the Analytics Engineering team to provide support globally and in localized languages. 

Product Expertise 

  • Be a product expert, maintaining knowledge of how to implement and troubleshoot solutions in the platform, including integrations with other systems.
  • Identify gaps in Seeq's capabilities required to meet customer needs and give feedback to the product organization to influence the product roadmap.
  • Ability to assess and position Seeq’s benefits relative to competitive products in the marketplace or in the customer’s ecosystem.
  • Work with the product team to design, implement, and test new functionalities that meet customer needs.

 Industry Expertise 

  • Build trust with customers through the application of industry-specific knowledge and awareness, including market and use case trends specific to their area. 
  • Collaborate with internal teams (including industry principals, product marketing, and solution consulting) to influence industry-specific strategy.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree (or equivalent experience) in a technical field such as chemical, mechanical, electrical, or industrial engineering; degrees in operations research, data analytics, or applied math will be considered.
  • Minimum of 5-7 years of experience in process engineering, reliability engineering, technical pre-sales engineering (SaaS business, OT space preferred), or other related industry fields.
  • Deep technical expertise in one or more industrial process manufacturing verticals and a sound understanding of broad market drivers and business priorities.
  • Examples of industrial process industries are chemicals, pharmaceuticals, power & utilities, metals & mining, food & beverage, pulp & paper, etc.
  • Empathy with and experience in the difficulties involved in trying to solve real-world business and industrial challenges involving dense time-series process data with inadequate or overly complex analytics tools, such as Excel, MATLAB, Python, BI tools, or otherwise.
  • Responsive and adept at building trust and rapport with customers, prospective customers, partners, and internal multidisciplinary teams.
  • Effective and influential technical communicator. Enjoys dissecting, articulating, and translating a combination of customer-stated and customer-implied needs. Able to communicate with subject matter experts, managers, directors, and C-level audiences.
  • Creative ability to develop and propose technical solutions leveraging the latest features and capabilities in the software and broader technology landscape. Programming experience in Python and/or other programming languages is a plus.
  • Ability to independently prioritize work based on account team strategy, customer business needs, and Seeq company objectives.

  • Python programming skills is a plus.

title: Backend Engineer (m/f/d)
description:
Python, FastAPI and PostgreSQL in a system we built entirely ourselves. Full stack welcome.

Berlin or nearby, hybrid. Full-time, permanent. Start: as soon as possible

What this is about

Careship helps families find reliable support in everyday life: all across Germany, through self-employed caregivers and our own employed caregivers. Behind both stands a platform we built entirely ourselves, live since August 2026: a Python backend, an internal staff portal, an app for customers and an app for caregivers.

The system covers everything from the first inquiry to payroll: matching, scheduling, care budgets, billing with care insurance funds, payment processing and digital contracts, plus email, chat, WhatsApp and phone calls in one inbox. It is live, it runs the operations of two companies, and it grows every week.

This is why we are looking for the second person in our permanent engineering duo.

Your role

You work as one of two engineers on our system, with a focus on the Python backend: data model, business logic, APIs and the integrations our operations run on. If full stack is your thing, the rest is open to you: the staff portal in Next.js and our two apps in React Native. You share responsibility and cover for each other, in everyday work and during vacations.

  • You build features from the data model through the business logic to the finished API endpoint, and all the way to the screen if you want.

  • You work on core topics like the budget engine, billing, the payroll pipeline and matching. Logic where diligence really counts.

  • You maintain code in production that real people use every day: our operations team, caregivers, and customers with their families.

  • You work directly with product and the tech lead, no layers in between. Requirements arrive as fully worked-out specifications from our knowledge base, not as two-line tickets.

  • You get freedom and real responsibility: the system is brand new, much of it is taking shape right now, and you help decide where it goes. The roadmap includes shift planning, analytics, a marketing module and an ambassador platform.

Our stack

  • Backend: Python 3.12, FastAPI, SQLAlchemy 2, Alembic, PostgreSQL, on Google Cloud (Cloud Run, Pub/Sub, Cloud Storage)

  • Portal: Next.js 16, React 19, TypeScript, MUI, TanStack Query, generated OpenAPI client

  • Apps: React Native with Expo, shipped through the app stores

  • Integrations: Google Workspace (Gmail, Calendar, Meet), Auth0, Aircall, WhatsApp and DATEV, plus payment and e-signature providers

  • How we work: AI-assisted. Specifications, code and reviews are created with AI support, as our everyday standard, not as an experiment.

What you bring

  • At least 3 years of experience in professional product development, more is a plus

  • Solid Python experience in production, ideally with FastAPI and SQLAlchemy or comparable frameworks

  • Confidence with relational databases and SQL, PostgreSQL in our case

  • You already code with AI support as a matter of course, ideally with real enthusiasm. For us this is a requirement, because it is how we work every day.

  • Diligence where mistakes cost money or trust: billing, payments, personal data

  • Fluent English. German is a plus.

  • Appetite for a small team with a lot of responsibility and a direct line to the people who use your software

Nice to have

  • TypeScript, React, React Native or Next.js, if you also want to work on the frontend

  • App store releases and Expo EAS

  • Google Cloud, Google Workspace APIs, or experience with payment and e-signature integrations

  • Experience in regulated domains such as health, care or fintech

  • WebSockets and real-time features

  • German language skills, since our domain and our specifications are in German

What we offer

  • A brand-new system with real room to shape it: two engineers, clear specifications, no decades-old legacy, and plenty of space to keep building

  • Freedom and responsibility from day one, flat hierarchies, no meeting marathons

  • Real social impact: your work helps seniors get support and makes sure caregivers are paid fairly and on time

  • Home office with regular shared days at our Berlin office

  • Several weeks per year of fully remote work, from abroad if you like

  • 30 days of paid vacation

  • A new MacBook with serious power

  • An annual learning budget plus two extra paid learning days

  • An Urban Sports membership

  • Deutschlandticket (Germany-wide public transport pass)

  • Regular team events

What happens next

Our process is deliberately fast and straightforward, in three steps: a short intro call, a technical interview, and finally a small case study plus meet the team.

No need to send us a novel. Your CV, GitHub or LinkedIn profile and a few sentences on why this is exactly your thing are plenty.

Compensation

The annual salary for this permanent, 40-hour-per-week role is EUR 60,000–70,000 per year.

Join us

If you match most of these requirements and want to apply your engineering skills to meaningful work, we encourage you to send us your application through the platform. We look forward to reviewing your background and discussing how you can contribute to our team in Berlin.

AI Developer / Full Stack Entwickler (m/w/d)

KI, Automatisierung & Softwareentwicklung | Werkstudent oder Teilzeit

Über uns

Wir sind MOUTH Propaganda aus Köln. Wir entwickeln und produzieren außergewöhnliche Produkte und Marketingkonzepte für Marken und Unternehmen. Von individuell gestalteten Eiskreationen bis hin zu kreativen Markeninszenierungen.

Neben der Weiterentwicklung unserer Produkte und Dienstleistungen investieren wir zunehmend in unsere digitalen Strukturen. Unser Ziel ist es, interne Prozesse intelligenter zu vernetzen, eigene Softwarelösungen zu entwickeln und die Möglichkeiten moderner KI-Technologien gezielt in unserem Unternehmen einzusetzen.

Dafür möchten wir unser Team um jemanden erweitern, der technisches Know-how, eigene Ideen und praktische Erfahrung mitbringt und Lust hat, diesen Bereich gemeinsam mit uns aufzubauen.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Entwicklung und Weiterentwicklung eigener Softwarelösungen und interner Dashboards

  • Aufbau und Integration von KI-Anwendungen, Agenten und automatisierten Workflows

  • Vernetzung bestehender Systeme über APIs und Schnittstellen

  • Entwicklung einer zentralen digitalen Infrastruktur für Vertrieb, Produktion, Verwaltung und Marketing

  • Anbindung und Auswertung von Daten aus CRM, Website, Social Media und weiteren Plattformen

  • Aufbau und Betreuung von Datenbanken, Cloud-Anwendungen und technischen Schnittstellen

  • Kontinuierliche Optimierung unserer Systeme im Hinblick auf Funktionalität, Sicherheit und Skalierbarkeit

Welche Projekte wir zuerst angehen, definieren und priorisieren wir gemeinsam. Du bringst dabei deine technische Perspektive ein und entwickelst eigenständig Lösungen, die zu unseren Anforderungen passen.

Das bringst du mit

  • Praktische Erfahrung in der Softwareentwicklung, idealerweise mit Python, JavaScript oder TypeScript

  • Erfahrung mit KI-gestützter Entwicklung, beispielsweise mit Claude Code oder vergleichbaren Tools

  • Sicherer Umgang mit APIs, Datenbanken und der Integration unterschiedlicher Anwendungen

  • Verständnis für Softwarearchitektur, Cloud-Infrastruktur und automatisierte Prozesse

  • Idealerweise Erfahrung mit MCP, n8n, Webhooks, Git oder KI-Agentensystemen

  • Die Fähigkeit, technische Projekte selbstständig zu strukturieren, umzusetzen und weiterzuentwickeln

  • Interesse daran, auch über den eigenen technischen Aufgabenbereich hinaus mitzudenken

Ein Studium oder eine Ausbildung im IT-Bereich ist willkommen, aber keine zwingende Voraussetzung. Viel wichtiger ist uns, dass du bereits eigene Projekte umgesetzt hast und praktische Erfahrungen vorweisen kannst.

Was dich bei uns erwartet

  • Die Möglichkeit, den digitalen Bereich eines wachsenden Unternehmens aktiv mitzugestalten

  • Eigenverantwortliche Projekte mit direktem Einfluss auf unsere Unternehmensentwicklung

  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit der Geschäftsführung bei der Planung und Priorisierung neuer Projekte

  • Kurze Entscheidungswege und Raum für eigene Ideen und technische Lösungsansätze

  • Ein kleines Team, in dem man sich kennt, gegenseitig unterstützt und gemeinsam etwas voranbringt

  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten und Beschäftigungsmodelle

  • Die Möglichkeit, moderne KI-Technologien nicht nur auszuprobieren, sondern produktiv einzusetzen

Wir arbeiten pragmatisch, direkt und mit einem hohen Anspruch an das, was wir machen. Du solltest dich in einem kleinen Unternehmen wohlfühlen, Verantwortung übernehmen wollen und Freude daran haben, Dinge von Grund auf zu entwickeln.

Rahmenbedingungen

Standort: Köln

Beschäftigung: Werkstudent, Teilzeit oder geringfügige Beschäftigung

Arbeitszeit: Flexibel nach Vereinbarung

Remote: Anteilig nach Absprache möglich

Deine Bewerbung

Ein klassisches Anschreiben ist bei uns nicht notwendig.

Wir möchten vor allem erfahren, mit welchen Technologien du bereits gearbeitet hast und welche Projekte du selbst umgesetzt hast.

Schick uns gerne Beispiele deiner bisherigen Arbeiten, beispielsweise über GitHub, eigene Anwendungen, Automatisierungen oder andere Softwareprojekte.

Im weiteren Bewerbungsprozess möchten wir anhand einer kleinen praktischen Aufgabe sehen, wie du an technische Herausforderungen herangehst und Lösungen entwickelst.

title: Senior iOS Developer (Remote)
description:
About Finom
 
Finom is a European tech startup headquartered in Amsterdam, and we’re on a journey towards revolutionizing the financial landscape for entrepreneurs worldwide. Our mission is to develop an all-in-one financial B2B solution that integrates banking functions, accounting, financial management, and invoicing into a seamless, mobile-first platform.
 
We recently closed a €115 million Series C equity round (around $133 million), bringing our total funding to approximately $346 million. This significant investment follows a $105 million growth funding round from General Catalyst, a long-term backer since 2021 known for supporting companies like Airbnb, HubSpot, KAYAK, and Stripe.
 
Finom's platform goes beyond traditional banking, offering invoicing and a growing suite of features, including AI-enabled accounting, aiming to simplify financial management for entrepreneurs. We're actively expanding our reach across key EU markets like Germany, France, the Netherlands, Italy, and Spain.
 
At Finom, we’re not just redefining the entrepreneurial experience — we’re empowering our employees to make a real difference. Your work matters, and your impact extends far beyond product metrics. We nurture innovation and an inspiring work environment where bold ideas thrive, prioritizing thorough research, swift implementation of solutions, and ensuring that every effort we make benefits our users, employees, partners, and our business as a whole.
 
Maintaining our start-up spirit, we prioritize thorough research, swift implementation of solutions, and ensuring that every effort we make benefits our users, employees, partners, and, of course, our business.

The Role

For hundreds of thousands of European entrepreneurs, our iOS app is Finom. It's how they check their cash flow over morning coffee, approve a payment between client meetings, and freeze a card the moment something looks off. We're mobile-first by conviction, not convenience — the app isn't a companion to the "real" product; it is the product. And as an AI-native platform, the features you build increasingly carry intelligence inside them: AI-powered accounting, smart categorization, and agentic workflows that quietly save business owners hours every week. When you ship something great, someone somewhere feels it the same day.

That's why we're not looking for someone to implement tickets. We're looking for a Senior Mobile (iOS) Engineer who thinks like a product builder — someone who cares deeply about the "why" behind what they're building, challenges assumptions when needed, and proactively spots opportunities to create better outcomes.

You'll be embedded in a cross-functional domain team — Backend, Mobile, ML/AI, QA, Design, and Product — that owns a shared product area end-to-end. No handoff culture, no "not my layer": everyone in the team is solving the same customer problem, and you'll shape solutions from the first product conversation to the moment the feature is live in users' hands. Fewer silos means more flow — and real, end-to-end ownership.

How We Build

Agentic development is table stakes at Finom — for every craft, mobile included. Our engineers work with Claude Code and similar harnesses daily, and we've made it a first-class part of how the company operates, not an individual productivity hack. We follow a shared SDLC approach built around Spec-Driven Development (SDD): features start as clear, reviewable specs that both humans and AI agents execute against, powered by a shared AI development toolbelt and a growing library of skills, rules, and context maintained across guilds. You won't be figuring out AI-assisted development alone — you'll join an engineering organization that has already invested in the infrastructure, standards, and shared practices, and you'll be expected to use them, improve them, and raise the bar for others.


What You'll Do

What You'll Do

  • Design and build new features for our iOS application, used daily by business owners across Europe: multi-account cash flow management, banking transactions and payments, physical and virtual card issuance and control, and AI-powered accounting automation.

  • Own outcomes, not just code. You'll follow your features into analytics, jump into customer issues without being prompted, and care about whether what you shipped actually moved the needle.

  • Build polished, responsive UIs with UIKit and SwiftUI — in a financial app, trust is built (or lost) in the details.

  • Drive technical decisions within your domain, discuss trade-offs openly with product managers, and explain constraints clearly to non-technical stakeholders.

  • Raise the bar on engineering quality — automated testing, thorough code reviews, and mobile security best practices are non-negotiable in a regulated fintech.

  • Mentor the engineers around you and contribute to CI/CD pipelines, tooling, and mobile best practices across the team.

    •  


Who You Are

Who You Are

You're pragmatic, learn quickly, and have a proven track record of shipping products that matter. Above all, you're curious — about the product, the users, the business, and how your technical decisions impact all three.

Curiosity. You want to understand the "why" behind every feature. You ask what problem it solves, question whether there's a simpler path, and explore how your decisions ripple into product, users, and revenue.

Business acumen. You connect your work to company objectives. You understand the "so what" behind every decision, and you'd rather ship the feature that moves the right metric than the one that's merely interesting to build.

Communication. You communicate clearly and concisely in English across technical and non-technical audiences — from fellow engineers to PMs to business stakeholders — and you genuinely enjoy the dynamics of a cross-functional team.

T-shapedness. Your iOS craft runs deep, but your curiosity runs wide. You'll peek at the backend contracts, ask questions about the ML models, and dive into analytics to understand how your features perform.

Ownership. You take responsibility not just for your code, but for the outcomes. You move without being prompted — whether that's improving team processes, jumping on a production issue, or mentoring a colleague.

Your Experience Includes

  • 5+ years of commercial iOS development with strong knowledge of Swift.

  • Deep understanding of OOP, SOLID principles, and design patterns.

  • Practical experience with the VIPER architectural pattern and the Coordinator navigation pattern — and the judgment to know when a simpler approach serves the product better.

  • Excellent knowledge of UIKit and experience (or a strong desire to grow) with SwiftUI.

  • Experience with layout development in code, particularly using SnapKit or similar tools.

  • Ability to write unit and UI tests.

  • Confidence with Git / GitLab, including setting up and maintaining GitLab CI/CD.

  • Hands-on experience with agentic development tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, or similar) as part of your daily workflow — writing prompts, configuring rules and skills, and critically evaluating AI-generated output with tests, linters, and review. This is table stakes for all engineering crafts at Finom, mobile included.

  • A builder's mentality: you care deeply about shipping great products, not just writing great code.


Nice to Have

Nice to Have

  • Background in fintech or financial products — you understand the stakes of working in a regulated environment.

  • Solid grasp of mobile security best practices (especially critical in our domain).

  • Experience profiling and optimizing UI performance — reducing rendering bottlenecks and hitting smooth 60/120fps on iOS.

  • Hands-on work with performance tooling: Instruments, XCTest, or similar.

  • Published apps on the App Store you're proud of.

  • An active GitHub profile with code you're happy to share.

  • Deeper agentic engineering experience beyond daily tool use — setting up agent environments and harnesses, authoring reusable skills and behavioral rules, or contributing to a team's shared AI development practices.

  • Understanding of model capabilities and limitations — knowing which model fits which task and how to manage the context window effectively.

  • Awareness of AI security risks — prompt injection, data leakage, and safe handling of untrusted inputs in agentic workflows.

Recruitment Flow
  • Recruiter Interview
  • First Technical Interview
  • Coding / AI assisted coding interview
  • Mobile System Design Interview
  • Team Fit Interview (peer interview)
  • Offer

What You Will Get In Return
 
Make a genuine impact on the product
 
Join our upward trajectory, and grow with us. We provide the resources and opportunities for continuous personal and professional development, empowering you to make a genuine impact on our evolving product.
 
Work in the EU
 
Embark on this exciting journey with us and enjoy the flexibility of traveling and working remotely or in a hybrid model across Europe.
 
Become a stock options holder
 
Unlock your inner entrepreneur and align your aspirations with ours through our Stock Options Program. This exciting opportunity is available to every team member, from junior team members to our founders.
 
Receive unwavering support and care
 
Finom stands by you at every step, embodying our commitment to your well-being and success reflected in our modern, friendly, and eco-conscious corporate culture. We offer constant support and care to ensure your Finom experience is successful and fulfilling.
 
Work & Swim program
 
Immerse yourself in our exclusive Work & Swim Program. Spend one month in a comfortable corporate apartment in enchanting Cyprus. It's the ideal opportunity to strike the perfect work-life balance while enjoying breathtaking Mediterranean views.
 
Equal Opportunity Statement 
 
At Finom, we're an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We embrace diversity and invite applications from all walks of life. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability status, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.

Sanctuary Computer - Development

At Sanctuary Computer weâre building a different type of technology shop â one that prioritizes close collaboration between the client and the craftsperson.

Our projects range from design-forward websites, to robust web apps, to native mobile development.

XXIX - Design

When we started XXIX in 2013, we set out to create a different kind of design studio and weâve thrived because we continually ask what a creative practice can be.

Index - Community

We nurture trust within the creative community through generosity and abundance of ideas and care.

garden3d TK â Media
